title: Customer Success Manager II
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Customer Success Manager II to join our Customer Experience team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help our SMB and Mid Market customers achieve success and maximise the value of Pleo’s solutions and be part of a dynamic and collaborative team as we scale our innovative expense management platform across the UK & Ireland

If you're excited about solving customer challenges, and driving growth through exceptional service and are passionate about Customer Success in the SaaS industry, then this is the opportunity for you!

 


WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO 

You’ll report to our CX Manager and work closely with teams in CX, Onboarding, AM, Sales and Product. Our team of 30 is highly collaborative and dedicated to Customer Experience.

 


WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Customer Success Manager II, your main markets will be UKI customers. You will:

 - Nurture, support and process expansion for any opportunity from the customer base

 - As a customer's trusted product advisor and business consultant advise them on how to create their ideal processes with the tool to optimise their value-add

 - Own the adoption journey of your customer portfolio (after the onboarding phase)

 - Collaborate across teams with different internal stakeholders such as product management, services & solutions, marketing, customer support, etc. to improve the entire customer experience

 - Receive, qualify and triage all inbound communication from all communication channels; email, Intercom (web chat), and/or other performance marketing channels

 - Cultivate key customers to become advocates of Pleo and the Fintech community

 - Manage day-to-day operations and long-term business relationships with our customers

 - Do everything in your power to prevent customers from leaving Pleo through measuring health scores, and product/ feature adoption and acting proactively on those

 - Optimise the product-market-fit by building the bridge between the customer's feedback and our product team

 


WHAT YOU BRING 


You’ll thrive in this role if:

 - You have 5+ years of prior experience in account management or sales or customer success roles

 - You have an open mindset that always looks for the positive. Your customers and colleagues find your energy contagious

 - You truly enjoy helping others move and improve. You love helping your customers scale and grow

 - You love goals and objectives. You don't always need to be given tasks – you create your own tasks while chasing your targets, and it motivates you to reach them

 - You love a fast-paced and dynamic environment, where you have different kinds of tasks - from customer calls to meetings with our product team

 - This is a high volume, high velocity role. Being able to think and do things at scale is a huge plus

 - You are a trustworthy person who always ensures that deadlines are reached, promises are kept, and you do what is expected of you

 - You are empathetic. You have a strong ability to feel how others are doing. You are also able to communicate in a very empathetic way and touch people's emotions

 - You are fluent in English
   
    


WHY IS THIS ROLE A GOOD FIT FOR YOU

 

This role is a good fit for you if:

 - You enjoy building long-term relationships with SMB and Mid Market customers and taking ownership of their success from adoption through expansion.

 - You thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment and feel energised by balancing customer conversations, internal collaboration, and proactive problem-solving.

 - You’re motivated by impact and outcomes — helping customers grow, spotting expansion opportunities, and turning feedback into meaningful product improvements excites you.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

 - You’re not motivated by customer-facing work or influencing customer outcomes through proactive engagement and collaboration.

 - You’re uncomfortable with project management or coordinating multiple initiatives at the same time.

 - You’re not motivated by upselling, cross-selling, or optimising the long-term value of your customers’ accounts.
   
    


HOW YOU’LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE 

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

 - Lead customer adoption projects to drive impact in helping SMB and Mid Market clients maximise the value of Pleo’s solutions.

 - Collaborate with Customer Success and Product teams to improve customer experience processes and feedback loops.

 - Grow your skills in relationship management and upselling strategies, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale.

We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills in customer success.

 


THE LOCATION

Lisbon, Portugal, or London, UK

title: Account Manager, Enterprise
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

You'll manage a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers and grow gross profit through renewals, upsell and expansion across Airwallex's product suite. You'll build trusted relationships with senior commercial, finance, operations, product and technology stakeholders, using strategic account plans, business reviews and customer insight to increase adoption, improve retention and identify new growth opportunities.

 - Grow existing customer accounts through renewals, upsell and expansion across Airwallex's product suite.

 - Build and execute strategic account plans that clarify customer objectives, stakeholder relationships, risks, renewal priorities and future growth opportunities.

 - Lead commercial negotiations, business reviews and cross-sell opportunities that demonstrate value, improve retention and support Net Revenue Retention.

 - Coordinate complex onboarding, escalations and customer initiatives across Sales, Product Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Operations, KYC and Onboarding, Legal, Customer Success and other internal teams.

 - Maintain accurate CRM records, opportunity tracking and forecasts while turning customer feedback into product, operational and go-to-market improvements.

You'll work from our London office three days a week.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essentials

 - 5 to 6 years of sales or account management experience, including experience managing complex enterprise or strategic customer relationships.

 - A proven track record of retaining and growing existing accounts through renewals, upsell, cross-sell or other expansion motions.

 - Experience managing multi-stakeholder customer relationships, including engagement with senior commercial, finance, operations, product or technology leaders.

 - Strong commercial, communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and build trusted relationships internally and externally.

 - Experience working cross-functionally to resolve customer issues, manage escalations and deliver complex onboarding, implementation or post-go-live initiatives.

 - Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, B2B SaaS or another technology environment with complex products. Experience with API-enabled products is an advantage.

Preferred

 - Experience managing enterprise accounts in payments, FX, cross-border payments, treasury, cards, embedded finance or other financial infrastructure products.

 - Experience developing strategic account plans, leading QBRs or executive business reviews, and building relationships with C-level stakeholders.

 - A data-driven approach to account health, forecasting, renewal planning and commercial prioritisation, with strong CRM discipline.

 - Curiosity, resilience and an entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-growing environment, adapt to evolving priorities and proactively solve complex customer problems.


YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you’re motivated by stretch goals.

 - You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

 - You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

 - You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.

 - You communicate clearly and directly across cultures, and you're thoughtful about how context shifts meaning across borders.


LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

Enterprise Business is about more than closing deals. This team helps large, often multinational organizations solve complex financial challenges that go well beyond a single product decision — moving money globally, managing treasury operations, embedding financial services across borders, and replacing fragmented financial workflows with one global system built to scale. You’ll be helping customers understand what is possible when their financial operations work as one global system.

It's a team for strategic sellers with a builder mindset, who combine strategic thinking with deep product knowledge: comfortable with long deal cycles, multiple stakeholders, and the kind of autonomy that comes from being trusted to create value, shape the deal, and move complex opportunities forward rather than follow a rigid playbook. If you want to work on high-consequence deals that genuinely change how large businesses operate financially, this is the place to do it.


APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search

title: Customer Success Manager, Beneficial Deployments EMEA
description:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role 
 Join Anthropic as an EMEA-based Customer Success Manager supporting our Beneficial Deployments team's work with nonprofits. You'll be a strategic partner and trusted advisor to mission-driven organizations across EMEA, spanning a range of impact areas. Your focus is driving activation, adoption, and value of Claude across Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, and the API. That means helping these organizations evolve how they work internally, and guiding them as they evolve how they serve their missions and constituents with AI.
 You'll work as a pod with your Account Executive and Applied AI counterpart. Within the pod, you'll decide what level of engagement each customer most needs and either personally deliver it or connect the customer to resources that serve their needs. CS-led engagements range from high-touch 1:1 partnerships to one-to-many cohort engagements, with the latitude to design other approaches where they serve customers better.
 As one of our early Customer Success Managers in EMEA, you'll be a pioneer: helping to build regional processes, establish new customer relationships, and represent Anthropic's brand in a high-growth market. You'll operate with significant autonomy while staying closely aligned with global teams, which calls for someone who thrives in ambiguous environments and works effectively across time zones.
 The insights you gather from these partnerships will directly inform our research priorities, product development, and strategies for beneficial AI deployment. As the voice of the customer, you'll help shape how we build and deliver AI systems that amplify social good.
 Key responsibilities 
• 
 Work as a pod with your Account Executive and Applied AI counterpart, building shared territory and success plans
• 
 Drive activation and adoption across your portfolio, using your judgment to match the engagement model to what each customer most needs
• 
 Use your knowledge of each customer and of regional nuances to plan usage proactively, understanding current and future consumption and adoption and how they create realized value for the customer
• 
 Build trusting relationships with nonprofit leaders, program teams, and IT staff to understand their mission, goals, and capacity
• 
 Guide customers in evolving how they work internally, with change management suited to mission-driven cultures, including Train the Trainer programs, Center of Excellence development, and enablement that respects capacity constraints
• 
 Help customers evolve how they serve their missions and constituents with AI, identifying high-impact use cases across program delivery, research, fundraising, and operations
• 
 Become an expert in Anthropic's products across the API, Claude for Enterprise, and Claude Code, guiding customers to the right solutions and keeping them current on what's new
• 
 Document and quantify value realized through social impact outcomes, program effectiveness, cost savings, and mission amplification, and share it in regular impact reviews that build the case for continued investment
• 
 Build the repeatable playbooks, enablement resources, and regional processes that scale across the EMEA portfolio, and bring customer insights back to Product and Research
 You may be a good fit if you have 
• 
 5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles (Customer Success, Consulting, Solutions Architecture, or similar), ideally supporting mission-driven organizations such as nonprofits, foundations, educational institutions, or government agencies
• 
 Experience working as part of an account team alongside sales and technical counterparts
• 
 Experience managing high-touch strategic accounts and designing one-to-many programs (cohorts, webinars, user communities, or similar), with the judgment to know which a customer needs
• 
 A track record of driving activation and adoption of new technology, including change management in organizations with limited technical capacity
• 
 Experience driving success across both consumption-based and seat-based business models
• 
 Technical fluency with AI/ML concepts, API integrations, and software implementation patterns, and the ability to explain them to audiences from frontline staff to executive leadership
• 
 A strategic mindset to identify opportunities for expanded social impact and turn them into actionable plans
• 
 Comfort operating with significant autonomy in an early-stage regional team, and working effectively with global colleagues across time zones
• 
 Passion for both AI and social impact work, with strong interest in ensuring frontier AI systems are developed safely, ethically, and deployed to benefit society
• 
 A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality
• 
 (Bonus) Fluency in French, German, Spanish, or Italian

title: Applied AI Delivery Lead - London
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

OpenAI’s largest and most strategic customers are turning AI ambition into deployments that change how their organizations work. As a Delivery Lead, you will own delivery of priority AI initiatives for these customers, leading complex, high-impact deployments from planning through launch and adoption.



You’ll establish an integrated delivery plan, drive execution against launch commitments, resolve blockers, and lead progress toward measurable customer value. You’ll partner closely with account and technical teams, FDEs, customers, and delivery partners to turn customer priorities into successful deployments. You’ll bring a clear view of delivery progress, risks, and expected outcomes, helping teams make informed decisions and connecting successful execution to consumption and growth.



This is a senior, customer-facing role for someone who can move between executive conversations and practical details that determine whether a deployment succeeds. You bring technical fluency, sound judgment, and the ability to create clarity and drive action in complex, evolving environments.






WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own delivery of priority AI initiatives. Lead complex customer engagements from scoping and planning through deployment, launch, and initial adoption.

 - Build and drive an integrated delivery plan. Establish clear scope, milestones, accountable owners, dependencies, resource needs, and success measures across customer, OpenAI, and partner teams.

 - Resolve blockers and drive decisions. Identify risks early, work through dependencies and resource constraints, and bring the right stakeholders together to resolve tradeoffs and keep delivery moving.

 - Lead launch readiness and activation. Drive rollout and enablement planning, address technical and organizational readiness gaps, and remove barriers to initial adoption and usage.

 - Connect delivery to customer value. Define expected outcomes and measurement approaches with customers and account teams. Track adoption and consumption, assess results against agreed baselines, and communicate the value achieved.

 - Provide a clear view of delivery health. Lead customer and internal delivery reviews that drive decisions and action. Communicate progress, launch confidence, risks, and implications for expected consumption and revenue timing.

 - Improve how we deliver. Turn customer experience into repeatable playbooks, practical tools, and actionable feedback for product and delivery teams.






WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 7+ years of experience leading complex enterprise technology deployments, customer delivery programs, or transformation initiatives involving multiple teams and partners.

 - A track record of driving programs from scope through launch and adoption, with accountability for delivery commitments and measurable customer outcomes.

 - Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to understand AI systems, APIs, integrations, enterprise architecture, security dependencies, and deployment risks.

 - The ability to translate customer priorities into actionable delivery plans with clear milestones, owners, dependencies, and success measures.

 - Strong judgment under ambiguity, including the ability to identify material risks, navigate competing priorities, and drive timely decisions.

 - Experience building trust with customers and leading across teams outside your reporting line while holding stakeholders accountable to shared commitments.

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage executives, technical specialists, and customer operators and explain complex delivery issues clearly.

 - Commercial awareness and an understanding of how deployment, adoption, and consumption contribute to customer value and growth.

 - A practical approach to building repeatable delivery methods while adapting to the needs of individual

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

We're looking for a Technical Program Manager, Customer Experience at Pleo. You’ll help turn Pleo’s CX transformation strategy into scalable technical capabilities that make it easier for customers to onboard, get support, realise value, resolve issues and grow with Pleo.

This is not a traditional project-management role focused on timelines, meetings and status updates. You’ll understand the customer and business problem, get into the technical details, translate requirements between CX and Engineering, challenge proposed solutions, manage technical dependencies, and drive programs from concept through implementation, adoption and measurable impact.




WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO 

You’ll report to our Director, CX and work closely with teams in Customer Success, Support, Onboarding, Digital Content and Self-Service, Voice of the Customer, and Revenue Operations. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to acting as a technical bridge between CX and Pleo’s Product, Engineering, Data and systems organisations. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Product, Engineering, Data and Analytics, Finance, Risk and Fraud, and Business Systems to ensure success and keep technical decisions tied to customer outcomes and business value.

 - Drive AI-enabled CX programs for self-service, agent productivity, onboarding, Customer Success, knowledge retrieval, QA and virtual customer-facing capabilities. Set scope, release criteria and quality gates for the engineers and data scientists building AI agents, without line management of those teams.

 - Automate repetitive CX workflows and reduce technical debt across customer-facing systems. Challenge automation that is covering up a broken process.

 - Lead technical programs with Support (routing, case management, escalations), Customer Success (health, lifecycle triggers, forecasting) and Onboarding (digital journeys, implementation tracking, time-to-value).

 - Own UAT coordination, business readiness and technical program governance for major CX releases, including decision logs, dependency and risk tracking, and architecture decisions. Escalate risks with recommendations, not just status.

 - Make sure CX signals reach Product, so recurring friction and customer needs become visible and actionable.

description:
Our Story
 
Hello there. We’re Zopa.
 
We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com! 
 
We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. 
 
If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife


Please note this role will be based "remotely" but will require regular travel to clients around the North East and Scotland
 
Zopa Auto Finance is expanding its regional team to build stronger dealer coverage across underdeveloped territories. You will own a regional patch, combining new-business development with hands-on account management, and work closely with dealer partners and internal onboarding, commercial, product, operations and risk colleagues.

• Identify and prioritise dealer prospects that fit Zopa Auto Finance’s growth strategy and risk appetite.
• Build a healthy regional pipeline and keep CRM activity, status and next steps accurate.
• Present Zopa’s proposition clearly and guide suitable partners through onboarding.
• Own day-to-day dealer relationships and maintain account plans that improve engagement, quality proposals, volume and long-term value.
• Use performance reviews to identify trends, risks and actions across volume, conversion, credit quality, pricing and customer outcomes.
• Support partners with training, product education and process guidance.
• Resolve partner queries and escalations quickly with internal colleagues.
• Share competitor and regional market insight to support Auto growth strategy.
• Proven sales experience and evidence of winning new business.
• Ability to build trusted B2B relationships and manage a regional portfolio.
• Commercial judgement that considers partner quality and customer outcomes.
• Confidence using data, insight and CRM to prioritise activity and improve performance.
• Organisation, resilience and self-motivation for a field-based role.
• Full UK driving licence and ability to travel regularly across the region.
• Motor finance, dealer finance or regulated commercial experience.
• Experience growing a territory, supporting partner onboarding or managing performance, risk or fraud considerations.

The team
The Delivery function is responsible for the first-class delivery of priority projects across product and engineering. As a Delivery Manager, you will work alongside experienced Delivery Managers, product and technical leads and a range of stakeholders to provide structure, coordination, visibility and momentum for some of the most exciting and impactful changes happening at Zopa Bank. 
You will lead smaller, less complex projects and support larger programmes, with the mentorship and support of the wider Delivery team to help you build confidence, capability and judgement as you grow. 
 

With seven engineering domains, twenty squads, five core products and a customer base growing by the day, there is always work to be done at Zopa, the purpose of the Delivery function is to ensure that the right people are doing the right work, at the right time and in the most efficient way possible.
 More than managing specific projects, the delivery function is tasked with creating an environment conducive to agility, predictability, momentum and continual improvement.
 1.Delivery Support 
 A blanket term for numerous responsibilities that drive two key outcomes, these are increased predictability and increased momentum. 
 The role will be expected to work alongside product managers, engineering managers and technical leads and duties include facilitating objective setting, road mapping, stakeholder engagement, surfacing and resolving blockers, shielding engineers from distraction and generally doing what needs to be done to allow squads to plan, prioritise and execute effectively.
 2.Agility 
 Agility is the ability to switch focus quickly and easily to meet the demands of the market, and this is now the expectation of any company operating within the Fintech industry and Zopa is no different. We are committed to the core agile methodologies and delivery frameworks which adhere to those principles. 
 A focus of this role is proactively working with teams to identify opportunities to embed, experiment and mature processes and ways of working, absorbing what is useful and discarding what is not. 
 3.Health and Happiness 
 The Delivery manager is not a line manager, but the role is responsible for being proactive in helping squads find time and space to reflect on and to improve team mood, morale and motivation.
• Take a collaborative, servant-leadership approach, supporting and empowering teams to do their best work.
• Are passionate about agile ways of working and how they can help teams deliver effectively.
• Bring people together across teams to solve problems and work towards shared goals.
• Have strong coaching and influencing skills, helping others build confidence and move forward.
• Demonstrate excellent situational awareness, adapting your approach to the needs of the team and project.
• Have experience delivering complex projects, managing competing priorities and keeping stakeholders aligned.
• Proficient experience using Jira and Confluence.
• Experience in playing the Scrum Master role for at least 3 years across multiples engineering teams.
• A Scrum Master (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM) certification
• Previously worked in a Fintech environment.
• Project/programme management experience.

title: Manager, Strategy & Operations, Regulatory & Compliance
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

Own and drive high-priority strategic initiatives across Regulatory & Compliance, from global market expansion and licensing roadmaps to operating model redesign and compliance transformation. You’ll turn complex regulatory and operational challenges into clear strategies, scalable frameworks, and practical execution plans, partnering with senior leadership and teams across Product, Engineering, Risk, Legal, Finance, and Operations.

 - Own strategic initiatives across market expansion, regulatory licensing, operating model redesign and compliance transformation.

 - Drive scalable frameworks and execution plans that translate regulatory strategy into operational outcomes.

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, Risk, Legal, Finance and Operations to identify opportunities for AI, automation and technology-enabled process improvement.

 - Build business cases and support implementation of transformation initiatives, tracking performance, operational efficiency and return on investment.

This role is based in London or Singapore. 




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essentials

 - 6+ years of total professional experience, including at least 4 years at a top-tier strategy consulting firm.

 - Experience delivering strategic projects within financial services, global payments, fintech or technology platforms.

 - Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous questions into clear hypotheses, analytical frameworks and operational roadmaps.

 - Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities, with a track record of translating complex data into actionable executive insights.

 - Excellent communication, storytelling and executive presence, with experience influencing senior stakeholders and matrixed global teams.

 - A founder’s mentality: you’re equally comfortable debating high-level strategy with the C-suite and rolling up your sleeves to build a new process from scratch.

Preferred

 - An advanced degree, such as an MBA or Master’s in Finance, Economics or Business.

 - Deep familiarity with global payments infrastructure, cross-border flows, digital wallets or multi-jurisdictional licensing regimes.

 - Hands-on experience leading digital transformation, process automation or AI implementation within financial operations or compliance.


YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You’re comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

 - You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

 - You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

 - You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

 - You come to the table with a point of view, not just a problem.


LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

Regulatory & Compliance is where we build the trust, discipline, and operational resilience required to scale a generational financial platform.

As Airwallex grows across 30+ markets, this team turns regulatory complexity into strategic control. You'll lead compliance, enterprise risk, and regulatory engagement in a way that protects the business while letting it move with conviction. Our ambition goes beyond meeting expectations: we're building a risk posture that acts as a competitive moat, grounded in ownership, proactive regulatory partnerships, and frameworks that scale globally while respecting local nuance.

It's a team for strategic operators with sharp judgment, high standards, and the confidence to execute at pace in a high-stakes environment. You'll thrive here if you can balance rigor with progress and influence across functions.

If you want to architect the benchmark for trust and resilience in global finance, your work here will have a massive impact.

About the team:

Finance & Corporate Development helps Airwallex grow with control. We’re a trusted partner to the business, providing actionable insights on performance, supporting market and product expansion and helping to shape the future of our product. We ensure that Airwallex meets its financial reporting, tax and safeguarding obligations globally. We work with existing and prospective investors to raise capital and ensure it is deployed effectively.



This is a team for people who want to reimagine how the office of the CFO works. We’re looking for founder-like energy, high integrity and a passion for technology. You’ll thrive here if you enjoy working cross-functionally, think from first principles and can balance speed of execution with analytical precision.


What you’ll do:

As Chief of Staff to our Group CFO, you’ll be the CFO’s right hand across three divisions: Finance & Corporate Development, People & Talent, and global Operations. You will run the operating rhythm that keeps those teams aligned, own the CFO’s most important projects from first framing to delivery, and help build a CFO-led programme that brings Airwallex closer to the finance leaders we serve.



You’ll work directly with the CFO, the CEO, the executive team and our investors.



This role is based in our London office.



Responsibilities:

 - Run the CFO’s operating cadences: Ensure the smooth running of the Finance, People & Talent and Operations divisions, driving divisional OKRs, business reviews, leadership team meetings and offsites.

 - Own strategic projects end to end: lead the CFO’s highest-priority cross-divisional projects, from problem definition to delivered outcome. Examples could include org changes, M&A integration, process redefinition and analytical work.

 - Shape executive and Board communication: Support the CFO in the creation of internal and external-facing materials, including Board, Exec and Investor materials.

 - Build the CFO go-to-market programme: partner with GTM to run CFO-hosted events, roundtables and a community for finance leaders, and track the commercial impact.



Who you are:

Minimum qualifications:

 - Proven experience, with a foundation in top-tier strategy consulting, private equity or investment banking and preferably some in-house experience in a fast-growth environment

 - Strong financial acumen: you build models, read a P&L and balance sheet fluently, and frame decisions in unit economics and return on investment.

 - A track record of leading complex, cross-functional programmes to completion

Preferred qualifications:

 - Prior experience as Chief of Staff to a C-Suite executive

 - Experience in payments, cross-border or another regulated financial services business.

 - Experience with M&A/corporate finance (including fundraising)

 - Experience building executive events or communities.

 - An entrepreneurial streak: you’ve founded a business or side project.

title: Partner Estate & Relationship Manager
description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. 
 We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.
 After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and combine their pensions with us. 
 With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!
 We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️
 📍UK Remote (with essential travel to our global offshore sites) | 💰£51,200 - £64,700 + Incentive Awards + Benefits ✨ 
 Our Global Ops Team ⭐️ 
 Monzo’s mission is to make money work for everyone. Our operational partners are an important part of how we scale brilliant customer service, support sustainable growth and build resilient and cost effective operations globally.
 Global Operations is responsible for the health, governance and strategic value of Monzo’s partner estate. We bring together the relationship, contract, commercial position, engagement and risk context so that each partner is managed through one joined up and proportionate view.
 As a Partner Estate & Relationship Manager, you’ll be the main ongoing relationship owner for the partners and suppliers assigned to you. You’ll work within the strategy, goals and standards set by the Senior Partner Estate & Relationship Manager, using strong judgement and a high level of independence to drive issues, opportunities and commitments through to resolution.
 You’ll apply Monzo’s Partner Management Framework, lead effective partner governance and make sure our relationships, contracts and commercial arrangements support the outcomes Monzo, Operations and our customers need.
 You’ll build strong working relationships with partner client management teams and Operations leaders globally. Operations will own detailed day to day service performance. You’ll stay closely connected to understand what is working, where partners are struggling and where the relationship, contract, commercial arrangements or partner environment need to change.
 This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You’ll lead through your expertise, judgement and influence, bringing together colleagues across Monzo and our partners to deliver shared outcomes.
 🔑 You’ll play a key role by... 
 Own your Partner relationships 
• Relationship & stakeholder ownership : Own the ongoing relationship for assigned operational and technical partners, building trusted and constructive relationships across internal and external teams to enable effective partner management.
• Framework & health oversight : Apply Monzo’s Partner Management Framework to maintain a risk-proportionate view of overall partner health, contract performance, commercial value, and risk.
• Proactive issue resolution : Identify risks, capability gaps, and opportunities early, driving prompt resolution or escalating material concerns with evidence-based recommendations.
 Lead Partner governance 
• Monthly review leadership : Plan and lead monthly partner reviews, synthesising overall relationship health into strategic, actionable narratives without duplicating line-by-line operational reporting.
• Governance & action tracking : Drive rigorous governance execution, ensuring accurate reporting, clear action ownership, and verified impact before closing commitments.
• Quarterly Business Reviews : Collaborate with the Senior Partner Estate & Relationship Manager to prepare clear, evidence-based QBR materials aligned with Monzo’s broader governance framework
 Manage contracts, commercial activity and records 
• Contract lifecycle and management : Own end-to-end contract management of partners assigned to you —including amendments, renewals, pricing models, and change notices—regularly reviewing and updating terms to align with Monzo's needs and enforcing compliance to hold partners accountable.
• Financial oversight & commercial value : Lead invoice reconciliation, spend forecasting, and budgeting alongside Finance, while driving initiatives to improve commercial value, flexibility, and customer outcomes.
• Reporting & stakeholder governance : Deliver data-backed monthly partner health reporting and collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Procurement, and Finance to ensure compliant, well-governed execution
 Enable operations globally 
• Operational & strategic alignment : Maintain continuous engagement with global Operations leads to understand and anticipate business needs, align partners with Monzo’s strategy, and translate priorities into clear partner commitments.
• Systemic issue resolution : Leverage service performance trends to identify macro issues, driving cross-stakeholder accountability to resolve complex, multi-service blockers.
• Contract support & service transition : Ensure core operational contract terms (e.g., forecasting, change, training) adapt to business needs, overseeing the smooth transition of new or updated services into ongoing governance.
 Deliver goals, improvements and valu e
• Strategic execution : Translate pillar goals into clear priorities for assigned partners, driving key workstreams across governance enhancement, Partner Management Framework adoption, and relationship recovery.
• Value & model optimisation : Build evidence-based proposals to enhance service quality, driving end-to-end execution of champion-challenger and outcome-based commercial models.
• Scalability & best practices : Identify process bottlenecks across relationship and contract management, leading continuous improvements to ensure frameworks scale effectively across the team.

title: Director, Regulatory Compliance UK

ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

We hire builders with founder-level energy—people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do.

As Director, Regulatory Compliance (UK), you will serve as the senior compliance authority and strategic partner for Airwallex’s rapidly expanding UK presence.  - Team Leadership & Culture: Build, coach, and scale a high-caliber UK compliance advisory and operations team while fostering a company-wide culture of risk accountability and ethical rigor.

YOU’LL THRIVE HERE IF

THE ROLE

Working directly with OakNorth's Chief Lending Officer, you'll help grow and scale our UK and US lending businesses.

WHAT YOU'LL DO


SHAPE GROWTH AND STRATEGY

This is Adyen 
 Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 
 For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster. 
 Head of Regulatory – EMEA
Adyen is seeking a strategic, high-impact, and visionary regulatory leader to serve as our Head of Regulatory – EMEA. In this role, you will be a senior leader in our Global Regulatory organization - including direct responsible for leading our Regional Counsel teams and Regulatory Strategy & Risk teams across EMEA .
Adyen is principally an EU-licensed credit institution with home-state supervision in the Netherlands. As such, Adyen’s regulatory footprint and licensing advantages in Europe form the strategic blueprint for what is possible for our business worldwide. You will lead a high-caliber team of senior regulatory experts who serve as the critical bridge between European supervisory expectations and our "Global-First" regulatory architecture. In this role, you will elevate our financial licensing position as a core differentiator in Adyen's right to win—transforming regulatory complexity into commercial opportunity and powering sustainable, controlled growth to achieve our ambition as the most customer-focused financial technology platform in the world.
 What you’ll do

• Cross-Functional 2LoD Leadership & Supervisory Presence 
• Act as a senior cross-functional leader across Adyen’s Second Line of Defense (Legal, Compliance, Risk, Internal Control and Data Privacy Office), building deep, collaborative relationships with leadership peers. 
• Position the EMEA Regulatory team as the essential first-analysis layer for emerging laws, regulations, and supervisory expectations across European markets, ensuring seamless translation into 2LoD risk frameworks and operational builds - in connection with their 2LoD counterparts. 
• Drive strategic engagement with key prudential and conduct regulators (including the DNB, FCA, ACPR, Bafin [and ECB]), positioning Adyen favorably and building long-term supervisory trust.

You possess a track record of transforming regulatory requirements into commercial speed and competitive advantages within the boundaries of risk appetite.

title: Strategy Analytics Manager
description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:



 - One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

 - Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

 - Profitable since 2017

 - Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

 - Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)



So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.



We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.




JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

 1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

 2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

 3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting



Lendable is revolutionising the credit card industry by making financial tools accessible, intuitive, and empowering. Zable is a Mobile-App first credit card that empowers customers to build their credit score while meeting their spending and borrowing needs sustainably.

We’re looking for an analytical, commercially-minded Strategy Analytics Manager to help us grow and scale the product exponentially. This is a dynamic role where you’ll tackle high impact business problems across a number of disciplines including pricing, financial forecasting, growth, credit risk, new product development and product analytics.

You’ll work cross-functionally to deliver insight-driven strategies that optimise performance, drive responsible growth, and put the customer at the heart of decision-making.

You’ll operate in a fast-paced environment where ideas matter more than hierarchy, and execution beats bureaucracy. Your work will directly influence who we serve, how we grow, and how we deliver sustainable value.

 
 

Your impact

 - Drive promotions & pricing strategy: Develop and optimise promotional and pricing strategies through data-driven analysis and experimentation, balancing customer engagement, growth, price elasticity and profitability while continuously refining approaches based on product performance and scenario modelling. Build deep insight into marketing campaign and conversion funnel performance, identifying opportunities to improve cost and conversion efficiency. Stay abreast of industry trends and competitor activity to ensure our products remain fit for purpose.

 - Financial forecasting & portfolio analytics: Collaborate closely with the Credit Risk Analytics, Growth and Data Science teams to understand how our products and portfolio are performing at a granular sub-segment level. Define key KPIs and develop detailed monitoring to track performance against these goals, and deliver actionable recommendations to improve outcomes. Use strategic analysis to shape and influence broader business strategy.

 - Evaluate expansion opportunities: Navigate through ambiguity to assess the feasibility of new product, channel and segment expansion opportunities. Create robust commercial assessment frameworks, build tooling where necessary (e.g. RoI or NPV models) and extract data to support these assessments and deliver clear, insight-driven recommendations.

 - Influence & execution: Collaborate with stakeholders across Credit Risk, Data Science, Product and Growth to bring your strategies to life. Present insights and recommendations to senior leadership - clear, concise, and backed by data. Approach every conversation with an open mind, valuing the strength of ideas over ego or hierarchy. Ensure your implemented strategies are working as intended once deployed in production, validating outcomes and iterating as needed.

 - Build & mentor a small team of analysts: In time, you will hire, develop and mentor a small team of high-calibre analysts, fostering both technical growth and strategic thinking. Build a culture where people seamlessly collaborate across functions, challenge the status quo, and consistently deliver best-in-class, customer-first solutions.

 
 

Your experience

 - 3+ years of experience in an analytics role in any discipline (e.g. Growth, Credit Risk, Product Analytics, Marketing, etc.)

 - Proficiency in coding - ideally SQL and Python

 - [Bonus] Experience in managing or mentoring analytical teams

 - [Bonus] Experience in an FCA-regulated financial services firm




LIFE AT LENDABLE

 - Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

title: Head of Compliance (12 month FTC)
description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 300 territories globally.

The Role:

As Compliance & Risk Lead, you are a key member of Paddle’s compliance team, reporting to our VP, Compliance. You work closely with legal, product, and operational teams to ensure Paddle remains compliant with global payments and fintech regulations as we scale rapidly.

The Paddle compliance function is critical to our operations and growth, enabling innovation while maintaining trust with customers and regulators. You lead the compliance team and collaborate across teams, bringing expertise in payments compliance, risk management, and reporting. You are instrumental in building robust systems to track, analyze, and report on compliance, ensuring Paddle stays ahead in a dynamic regulatory landscape.

The role is based in the UK but global in scope, reflecting Paddle’s international reach.

What you'll do:

You will partner with our Compliance, legal and other teams across Paddle to integrate compliance into our operations, with a heightened focus on building scalable monitoring and reporting:

 - Team leadership: Hire, onboard, and manage compliance professionals, fostering a collaborative and high-performing team to support Paddle’s global compliance needs.

 - Payments compliance: Develop and refine compliance policies and procedures to ensure adherence to global card scheme rules, consumer protection laws and payments regulation (as applicable).

 - Compliance monitoring: Design and oversee simple tech-enabled monitoring programs to track compliance with internal policies and external regulations, using data-driven tools to identify trends and potential risks proactively.

 - Reporting: Deliver compliance reporting for internal stakeholders at all levels (e.g. senior leadership, the Board, product teams) and external regulators, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and clarity to demonstrate Paddle’s regulatory adherence.

 - Risk management: Develop and manage Paddle’s enterprise risk management program, collaborating with teams across the business to identify risks, embed controls and report on their effectiveness.

 - Regulatory research: Work with the legal team to stay ahead of evolving payments, consumer and fintech regulations, advising on their impact and integrating findings into monitoring and reporting frameworks.

 - Incident response: Lead investigations into high-risk complaints and/or compliance breaches, coordinating with legal and operational teams to resolve issues, and produce detailed incident reports for internal review and regulatory submission as needed.

We'd love to hear from you:

 - You have 6-8 years of compliance experience, ideally in payments and/or in fast-growing businesses, with a proven ability to implement and manage scalable monitoring and reporting systems.

 - You have deep expertise in data protection, card scheme rules and payments regulation (e.g., PSD2, AML/KYC) and hands-on experience in fintech or SaaS environments.

 - You’ve worked in a high-growth scale-up, building compliance frameworks that emphasize real-time monitoring and detailed reporting to support rapid expansion.

 - You’re an exceptional communicator, able to distill compliance data into concise, actionable insights for diverse audiences—from engineers to regulators.

 - You thrive in a fast-paced environment, balancing proactive monitoring with the ability to respond swiftly to competing demands.

 - You’re detail-oriented, with a passion for ensuring compliance is not just met but demonstrably provable.

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:



 - One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

 - Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

 - Profitable since 2017

 - Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

 - Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)



So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.



We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.




JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

 1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

 2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

 3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting



Zable is the fastest growing credit card in the UK and is revolutionising the credit card industry by making financial tools accessible, intuitive, and empowering. Whether they're building their credit score or looking to save money through refinancing or market-leading offers, we help customers meet their spending and borrowing needs sustainably.

We’re looking for an analytical, commercially-minded Associate Director to own our prime lending strategy and help us scale it fast. You'll own how we price, market and grow our prime business, build and lead a high-calibre analytics team, and put the customer at the heart of every decision.

You’ll operate in a fast-paced environment where ideas matter more than hierarchy, and execution beats bureaucracy. Your work will directly shape who we serve, how we grow, and how we deliver sustainable value.


YOUR IMPACT

 - Own the prime strategy & economics: Set the vision and roadmap for prime, define the KPIs that matter and own the targets for growth, balances and risk-adjusted returns. Track the portfolio at a granular sub-segment level with Credit Risk, and act fast when things move off plan. Relentless drive to grow the product sustainably, with the energy to bring others with you.

 - Drive pricing & promotions: Own APRs, promotional offers (balance transfer, purchase, etc.), cashback, and fees. Use experimentation and scenario modelling to find the right balance of customer value, growth and profitability, with fair value under Consumer Duty built in.

 - Model-driven strategy: Partner with Data Science to bring advanced models into pricing and acquisition decisions, turning predictive insight into measurable commercial results.

 - Fuel growth: Partner with Growth to win prime customers across all channels. Build deep insight into campaign and funnel performance, and keep finding ways to improve cost and conversion.

 - Stay ahead of the market: Know prime customers and competitors inside out, working with Product to keep our proposition sharp and adapting the product to meet customer needs.

 - Influence & execution: Drive decisions with the senior leadership team through clear, concise, data-backed proposals. Value the strength of ideas over ego or hierarchy, and roll up your sleeves to turn strategy into action. Take ownership, solve problems and make sure things get done.

 - Build & lead an exceptional team: Hire and lead an exceptional team, from Analyst through to Senior Manager. Build a culture where people challenge the status quo, collaborate across teams, act quickly and push for better outcomes. Use AI to move faster, deepen analysis and raise the bar on what the team can deliver.


YOUR EXPERIENCE

 - 8+ years in pricing, strategy, analytics or commercial roles within unsecured lending

 - 5+ years leading analytical teams, ideally including managers

 - Proven track record of owning and growing a portfolio, product or P&L

 - Deep understanding of pricing, credit risk and lending unit economics

 - Strong analytical skills, ideally SQL and Python

 - AI-first mindset, radically increasing the pace at which ideas can be sized, tested and implemented

 - Proven ability to influence senior leaders and inspire teams to deliver ambitious outcomes




LIFE AT LENDABLE

 - Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

 - Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

 - Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

 - Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

 - Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

 - Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

 - Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

 - Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

title: Head of Product - Cards
description:
Head of Product - Cards - Amsterdam 



Build with us

Businesses deserve better from finance. Less friction, more freedom. Since 2004, Mollie has been on a mission to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies trust our all-in-one platform to get paid, manage money and grow on their terms. Simple, scalable and built with real businesses in mind.

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintechs, with 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations. Our people make this growth possible. We move fast, build with purpose and care deeply about our customers. Whether you're solving problems, building market-leading products or exploring how AI can make work smarter, you'll have the freedom to create and the trust to deliver.

If you're ready to grow, shape the future of fintech and join an ambitious, high-performing team, this is the place for you.



Your impact

Cards is one of the most strategically important products at Mollie. It is the primary payment method operating at a global scale and the central enabler for Mollie to serve larger, more sophisticated merchants. As the accountable lead for online cards acceptance, you will own one of the highest net revenue-generating areas in the business, and your work will directly shape Mollie's ability to compete for and retain enterprise and mid-market merchants.

As the Head of Product for Cards Acquiring, you will own the end-to-end product strategy and execution for one of the most critical payment methods. You will bridge the gap between heavy technical infrastructure and high-impact commercial enablement. Leading a cross-functional team of around 20 people that includes product delivery managers, a product partnership person, a dedicated data person, and a PMM, you will scale Mollie’s cards capabilities beyond Europe, unlock new merchant categories, and ensure our proposition wins the hearts of highly sophisticated merchants. You will also work directly with payment schemes and external partners, making decisions that influence both the product roadmap and Mollie's broader positioning in the market.

The cards domain is expected to become an increasingly primary driver of Mollie's growth over time, with the potential for the online and in-person card acceptance platforms to converge and expand the scope of this role significantly. If you want to own something that matters at a company that is moving fast in the right direction, this is it.



What you'll ship

 - End-to-end product ownership: own the full cards acceptance product lifecycle—from deep technical infrastructure and processing stability to commercial enablement.

 - Go-To-Market & commercial enablement: lead the GTM strategy for new card features in tight lockstep with Product Marketing (PMM) and Commercial teams. You'll translate complex technical capabilities into crystal-clear value propositions that our sales teams can run with.

 - Global scale: drive the geographic expansion of our cards product, building out capabilities beyond Europe to support Mollie’s international growth.

 - Portfolio optimisation: Identify untapped merchant vertical opportunities and make data-driven decisions to maximise net revenue across the entire cards portfolio.

 - Team Leadership: Manage, coach, and scale a high-performing product team.
   
   

What You’ll Bring

 - Commercial & GTM Strategy: A proven track record of launching successful financial/payment products. You know how to price, position, and package features alongside PMM to win market share.

 - Partnership acumen: deep understanding of direct vs. indirect relationship strategies in the payments ecosystem and their respective commercial implications.

 - Technical depth: you aren't afraid of complexity. You can comfortably navigate the underlying technical architecture of cards acquiring, including the intricacies of the PCI compliance landscape.

 - Operational scale: experience managing operations-heavy environments and a proven ability to build scalable organisational structures that handle massive transaction volumes.

 - Customer obsession: this is non-negotiable at Mollie. You have a relentless drive to understand merchant pain points and build products that genuinely delight them.

 - Leadership: experience leading and developing cross-functional teams. You know how to cultivate a culture of high performance, accountability, and psychological safety.
   
   

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.



Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.



AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

title: Manager, Payments/Scheme Economics
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

You’ll help Airwallex manage and improve the economics of card payments, with a focus on scheme fees and interchange across Visa and Mastercard. You’ll turn complex network rules and payment data into accurate configurations, actionable analysis and decisions that improve cost visibility and margin performance.

 - Own payment-cost analysis across scheme fees, interchange and network rules, identifying changes and translating them into clear financial, product and operational requirements.

 - Maintain accurate fee tables, eligibility criteria and transaction-level logic with Product and Engineering, ensuring payment-cost calculations and customer billing reflect current network rules.

 - Build models and reporting across markets, products, payment methods and transaction types to identify margin drivers, anomalies, leakage and opportunities to improve payment economics.

 - Support cost and margin optimisation through transaction qualification, BIN routing, cost configuration and related levers, contributing to pricing, product design, market launches and commercial decisions.

 - Strengthen governance, testing, reconciliation and controls by comparing expected costs with actual network charges and helping drive root-cause resolution.

 - Partner with Finance, Product, Engineering, Data, Operations and external payment partners to resolve scheme pricing, interchange and rule-related questions.

You’ll work from our London office three days a week.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essentials

 - Experience in payments, acquiring, issuing, card networks, payment infrastructure or a related role, ideally within a global PSP, acquirer, scheme, issuer or fintech.

 - Strong knowledge of card payment economics, particularly Visa and Mastercard interchange, scheme fees, transaction qualification and network rules.

 - Experience translating complex payment rules, fee schedules or network requirements into system logic, configurations and controls.

 - Experience working with payment-cost systems or controls, including interchange tables, scheme fee logic, BIN-based rules, transaction attributes or similar payment configurations.

 - Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities, including experience working with transaction-level data, economic modelling and reconciliation of expected versus actual payment costs.

 - Commercial judgment and the ability to connect payment mechanics to pricing, product decisions and margin optimisation.

 - Exceptional attention to detail and ownership, with the discipline required to manage complex rules where small errors can create meaningful financial impact at scale.

 - Strong cross-functional execution, with the ability to work effectively across Product, Engineering, Finance, Data, Operations and external payment partners.

Preferred

 - Experience partnering directly with Visa, Mastercard or other payment networks.

 - Experience applying AI or advanced analytics to rule interpretation, anomaly detection or payment-cost optimisation.


YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

 - You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

 - You have experience at a fintech, payments company, or other highly regulated business.

 - You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

 - You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.


LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

Finance & Corporate Development helps Airwallex grow with control. We’re a trusted partner to the business, providing actionable insights on performance, supporting market and product expansion and helping to shape the future of our product. We ensure that Airwallex meets its financial reporting, tax and safeguarding obligations globally. We work with existing and prospective investors to raise capital and ensure it is deployed effectively.

This is a team for people who want to reimagine how the CFO office works. We’re looking for founder-like energy, high integrity and a passion for technology. You’ll own complex, consultative sales cycles from prospecting and discovery through commercial negotiation, contract signature and launch.

 - Build relationships with vertical SaaS companies, marketplaces, fintechs and other platforms.
