title: Head of Direct Sales Excellence
description:
Head of Sales Excellence, Direct Sales 
 Team description 
 Direct Sales at SumUp spans Telesales and Key Accounts teams across multiple European markets, each led locally rather than by one central head, so you'll be the driver of keeping priorities, performance and ways of working aligned across the whole channel. You'll step into a pivotal year: Key Accounts is being scaled up, Telesales is shifting further into outbound selling, and new AI tools are being tested to help reps work smarter. This is a 12 month assignment covering parental leave, giving you full ownership of a senior, cross market leadership role with real initiatives to drive and a team to lead, not just a holding position.
 What you'll do: 
• Build one clear view of how Telesales and Key Accounts are performing, spotting issues and improvement opportunities early
• Run the channel's quarterly goal setting and keep initiatives on track, flagging risks and decisions before they become blockers
• Lead change across the channel, from readiness and communication to checking that new ways of working actually stick
• Turn feedback from sales teams into a prioritised list of fixes and improvements, working closely with the Enablement team
• Coordinate initiatives across Pricing, Commercial Planning, Analytics and other partner teams so every workstream has what it needs to launch
• Lead and develop a small team of sales excellence specialists, taking on the most complex initiatives personally
 What you'll bring: 
• Significant experience leading sales operations, commercial operations, revenue operations or a similar function at a senior level, ideally including people leadership
• Proven track record of partnering with senior Sales leaders to shape channel strategy and turn business priorities into clear, actionable goals
• Strong skills in commercial performance analysis, able to read funnel, revenue and productivity data and translate it into practical recommendations
• Confidence influencing senior stakeholders across Sales, Product, Marketing and Finance without relying on direct authority
• Comfort working through ambiguity while leading complex, cross functional programmes from strategy through to execution
 Nice to have: fluency in French, German, Spanish or Italian.
 Why you should join SumUp 
 🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our central London Bridge location, wrapped in historic charm and modern flair. This involves an office-first setup 
 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced 
 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success 
 🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave, plus bank holidays and special leaves 
 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education 
 🏥 Health matters: private health insurance, including optical and dental
 🚗 Life made easier: salary-sacrifice commuter benefits via Gogeta 
 💼 Financial security: retirement scheme (SumUp matches 7% when you contribute 5%) 
 🛡 Peace of mind: life insurance from MetLife for 2× your salary 
 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service 🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team
 About SumUp 
 Be empowered to do more that matters.
 At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 39 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.
 Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 4,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.
 SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website , and follow our journey on LinkedIn , Instagram , and TikTok .
 Job Application Tip 
 We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

title: Senior Product Manager (Growth)
description:
Fin , now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.
 Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.
 Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.
 Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
 What's the opportunity? 
 Self-serve is where the majority of our customers start their journey, and the Growth team owns that journey end to end. This role owns the self-serve existing business : once a customer converts to paid, the account is yours - through every stage of its lifecycle, as it adopts more of the platform, grows its usage, and deepens its reliance on Fin.
 Your mandate is to grow the value of the self-serve base: drive expansion, strengthen retention, and accelerate adoption of Fin and our newest products across thousands of paying customers. You'll own a book of business, a roadmap, and a cross-functional motion that spans product, lifecycle, data, and go-to-market. It's a rare Growth remit with a clear number to move and a lot of room to build the motions that move it.
 What will I be doing? 
• Own the self-serve existing business book. Own the remit end to end - from the moment a customer converts to the point they renew, expand, or leave - and be accountable for the net growth of that book.
• Grow Fin adoption. Get more customers using our AI Agent across the existing base, and help the customers who already use it automate more of their support.
• Defend and expand. Build the retention and expansion motions that grow the book - combining in-product experiences, lifecycle messaging, and a data/signal layer that flags which accounts need attention and when.
• Connect self-serve and sales. Design smooth, well-defined handovers between self-serve and sales in both directions, so the right customers get the right motion.
• Fix the key journeys. Partner with core product teams to remove friction on the journeys that matter most to self-serve customers - onboarding and activation, Fin setup and go-live, plan changes and expansion, billing and plan management.
• Land new products & features. Drive attach and adoption of new products & features across the self-serve base.
• Understand the customer. Deeply understand the customers you're serving through research, data, and direct interactions, and turn that understanding into a clear, prioritised roadmap you communicate to build alignment.
• Build and ship. Collaborate with engineers and designers to ideate, build, and ship solutions, and leverage AI to increase your efficiency and accelerate product development.
• Measure impact. Evaluate impact through quantitative and qualitative measures, own product quality, and model our company values and R&D principles in how you lead.
 What skills do I need? 
 There is no minimum years of experience, and no need to have held the PM title. We care about your impact, drive, and potential - former founders, strategy & operations leaders, and consultants are as welcome as career PMs. The common thread is end-to-end ownership of a problem and the outcomes that follow. We'll be looking for evidence you've applied and grown these skills:
• Growth and lifecycle expertise. You've owned retention, expansion, adoption, or monetisation for a self-serve or product-led business, and you know how to move those numbers.
• Sharp customer focus and problem framing. You get to the real customer problem through research, data, and direct conversations before deciding what to build.
• Strong data fluency. You're comfortable working with funnels, cohorts, and customer signals to find opportunity, size it, and measure impact - and you make decisions from evidence, not instinct.
• Compelling roadmaps. You build and communicate a roadmap that makes the what, when, and why obvious to everyone who needs to align behind it.
• Excellent product judgment. You balance customer needs, business impact, and technical constraints, and you know what to ship now versus later.
• Cross-functional leadership. You drive outcomes across product, design, engineering, data, lifecycle marketing, CS, and sales - influencing teams you don't own.
• AI fluency. You understand how LLMs and AI agents work well enough to assess feasibility, make informed product decisions, and use AI to accelerate your own work.
• Outcome-oriented. You define success clearly, share progress openly, and hold yourself to measurable impact.
 #LI-Hybrid
 Unleash Your Potential 
 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

 - Identify opportunities to improve payment performance through merchant data, transaction trends, and industry benchmarks.

 - Build and refine payment optimisation methodologies and playbooks that help Airwallex stay ahead of industry developments.

 - Lead deep-dive conversations with enterprise merchants about payment performance, acting as a trusted strategic advisor to improve transaction outcomes.

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to develop optimisation levers, including AI- and machine-learning-powered approaches to smart routing, cost reduction, and payment success.

 - Translate merchant feedback and frontline insights into product roadmap recommendations.

 - Enable Sales and Account Management teams with practical payment optimisation knowledge, tools, and training.

 - Build relationships with external stakeholders, including card issuers and payment networks, to improve the end-to-end payment experience.

You'll work from our London office three days a week.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essentials

 - 5+ years of experience in payments, with strong knowledge of e-commerce, card-based processing, and payment optimisation.

 - Strong understanding of card network rules, local payment methods, and regulatory requirements such as PSD2 and PSD3.

 - Strong analytical skills and experience using data and business intelligence tools to identify opportunities and explain performance trends.

 - Experience turning complex analysis into clear recommendations for both technical and commercial audiences.

 - Excellent communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging enterprise clients and senior stakeholders.

 - Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, and Account Management teams.

 - A self-directed approach and the ability to make progress in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

 - Intellectual curiosity and a practical approach to solving complex customer and payment problems.

Preferred

 - Experience with BI and data platforms such as Looker, Power BI, Tableau, or Databricks.

 - Experience working with payment optimisation, smart routing, fraud mitigation, or transaction success-rate improvement.

 - Experience engaging directly with card issuers, payment networks, or other global payments stakeholders.

 - You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

 - You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

 - You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

 - You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

Merchant Services at Airwallex is made up of two teams: Solutions Engineering and Technical Support, working together to turn customer-facing technical work into product progress. Across both teams, we help businesses design, integrate, launch, optimize, and scale on Airwallex's global financial infrastructure, covering solution architecture, delivery, technical account management, optimisation, and support.

The mandate is simple: solve for the customer in front of us, and build for the customers we haven't met yet. Sitting close to Product, Engineering, and Design means the patterns you see in real customer integrations can become better APIs, documentation, tooling, onboarding paths, and product capabilities. The hard part is doing both at once: shipping for today's customer without losing the signal that improves the product for the next.

This is a team for people who can earn trust with builders, reason through complex systems, communicate clearly, and stay grounded in commercial outcomes. If you want to work at the intersection of agentic finance, customer impact, and product development, this is where your work compounds.

title: Public Affairs Campaigns Lead, EMEA
description:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team 
 The Government Relations & Public Affairs team represents Stripe to governments, regulators, industry partners, and broader stakeholder audiences. We help the company understand and adapt to a changing global policy environment, anticipate and respond to challenges, and advocate for the needs of our users and the online economy. The team works closely with Policy Strategy, Legal, Communications, Marketing, and regional product and go-to-market teams to ensure coordinated, consistent engagement worldwide.
 What you’ll do 
 Stripe is looking for a Public Affairs Campaigns Lead to build our profile in the policy landscape across EMEA, with a particular focus on the EU, its Member States, and the UK. Working closely with colleagues in Government Relations, Communications and Marketing, you will help turn Stripe’s policy priorities into compelling campaigns, develop thought leadership, and deliver policy events that reach the right audiences and shape the conversation. This person will be a truly great campaigns operative, someone willing to roll up their sleeves and who prides themselves on executing with excellence. You will help make Stripe’s ideas and expertise, and our users’ experiences, more visible and impactful - building a distinctive, credible voice for Stripe among policymakers and the wider policy community. If you are up for the challenge, we would love to hear from you!
 Responsibilities 
• Help develop and deliver public affairs campaigns that advance Stripe’s policy priorities across EMEA, taking campaigns from idea to execution, with clear objectives, target audiences, messages and tactics. 
• Develop thought leadership that shapes the debate, including distinctive reports, commentary and campaign content that draws on Stripe’s expertise, data and users’ experiences. 
• Deliver policy events with lasting impact, putting Stripe and our users in front of those who create the policy landscape. 
• Work with Government Relations and Policy Strategy colleagues to translate complex issues into compelling narratives and campaign materials that give policymakers a reason to pay attention. 
• Bring the right channels and partners together to extend campaigns’ reach and influence, working with Government Relations colleagues as well as 
• Communications, Marketing, industry groups, think tanks and users. 
• Build Stripe’s policy brand by connecting individual campaigns, publications and events into a recognisable, credible voice in the region’s policy conversations. 
• Contribute to the development of Stripe’s global public affairs campaigns capability, working closely with Public Affairs colleagues in the US and across the globe.
 Who you are 
 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
 Minimum requirements 
• Minimum 3+ years of experience in public policy, public affairs, campaigning, government relations, communications, advocacy, or related fields.
• Demonstrated experience executing political or advocacy campaigns, building coalitions, coordinating stakeholders, and delivering events with impact.
• Excellence in execution, someone able to move at speed to deliver incredible events, compelling content and impactful campaigns.
• A terrific communicator and writer, fluent in English and adept at producing compelling thought leadership and campaign materials, clear briefings and impactful short-form messaging.
• Interest in and understanding of policy, government affairs, and the tech and/or payments ecosystem.
• Comfortable working with cross-functional partners and in an international environment.
• Proven collaborator who is resourceful, execution-oriented, and able to work both independently and as part of a team.
• Willingness to travel frequently for meetings and events.
• Passionate about Stripe’s mission of helping ambitious businesses grow and thrive.
• Empathy, humility, and some comedy.
 Preferred qualifications 
• Professional experience and existing relationships within the EU and/or UK policy and public affairs ecosystems. 
• Experience supporting global or multi‑jurisdictional public affairs campaigns, including adapting and deploying global messaging and playbooks for local audiences. 
• Background or advocacy in technology, financial services, or related sectors. 
• Language skills beyond English are an advantage.
 What we can offer 
• The chance to shape global public affairs campaigns and programmes at a fast-growing company touching millions of businesses.
• A collaborative, mission-driven Government Relations & Public Affairs team that works closely with Policy Strategy, Legal, Communications, and Marketing around the world.

title: Fraud & Disputes Specialist
description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:



 - One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

 - Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

 - Profitable since 2017

 - Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

 - Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)



So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.



We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.




JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

 1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

 2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

 3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting



About the role:

As a Fraud & Disputes Specialist, you'll be at the forefront of protecting our credit card customers and business from financial crime, playing a vital role in our Fraud and Financial Crime Team. You'll have end-to-end ownership of complex investigations, making a direct impact on customer experience, and the effectiveness of our UK & US card products.



Key Responsibilities:

 - End-to-End Case Ownership: Investigate and resolve complex third-party credit card fraud, consumer card disputes (including Section 75 claims), and chargebacks, ensuring meticulous accuracy and compliance with Mastercard guidelines.

 - Customer-Centric Resolution: Communicate empathetically and clearly with customers throughout the process, managing challenging scenarios like account takeovers and scams with professionalism and sound judgment.

 - Operational Excellence & Digital Adoption: Execute structured processes using our digital systems, proactively identifying trends and suggesting improvements to controls, workflows, and automation opportunities. You'll be a champion for new technologies, helping us work smarter and faster.

 - Continuous Learning: Stay ahead of emerging fraud typologies, regulatory changes, and new operational tools, sharing your expertise and contributing to a collaborative, improvement-focused team environment.



Your Experience & Skills:

 - Essential: Prior experience working with credit or debit card fraud, disputes, or chargebacks.

 - Advantageous: Good working knowledge of scheme rules (especially Mastercard) and relevant regulatory standards in the UK and/or USA.

 - Ability to confidently navigate and resolve complex customer scenarios with empathy and professionalism.

 - Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, thriving in a fast-paced and change-driven environment.

 - Digitally savvy and eager to embrace automation and new technologies.

 - Detail-oriented and process-driven, with a knack for spotting inefficiencies and suggesting practical improvements.

 - Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.



Your Profile & Approach:

 - Customer-Focused: Deeply committed to customer protection and delivering positive outcomes.

 - Accountable: Takes personal ownership for every case and champions process enhancements.

 - Proactive & Solutions-Oriented: Open to new approaches, including automation and digital transformation.

 - Constructive & Collaborative: Eager to identify better ways of working and contribute to a supportive team culture.

 - Maintains the highest standards of confidentiality, integrity, and compliance.



Interview Process:

1) A 15 minute Cognitive Assessment

2) A 30 minute call with a member of the Talent team

3) An onsite Interview and assessment with the Fraud & Disputes Manager

4) Interview with the Head of Fraud and Financial Crime




LIFE AT LENDABLE

 - Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

 - Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

 - Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

 - Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

 - Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

 - Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

 - Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

 - Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our blog https://blog.lendable.co.uk/!

description:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. https://www.thetrainline.com/terms/sustainability-faqs Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.



Introducing the Trainline Partner Solutions Team 👋

Trainline Partner Solutions (TPS) is building the world's number one rail platform - giving partners everything they need to grow rail by making it simpler to access, sell, service, and scale, so more travellers choose rail with confidence. TPS powers the technology that enables Travel Management Companies (TMCs), Online Booking Tools (OBTs), and other distribution partners across the UK and Europe to sell and manage rail travel seamlessly.

This role sits at the heart of that mission, leading the product strategy for TPS Distribution within B2B. Reporting into the Product Director, you will own the product vision and P&L accountability for distribution, working in close partnership with Sales and Account Management to maximise revenue from existing partners and identify new commercial opportunities. Your key stakeholders span Data Science, UX, Engineering, and Commercial Finance, and you will lead a team of four Product Managers, with direct line management responsibility for three of them.



In this role as the Head of Product - TPS Distribution, you will... 🚄

 - Own the end-to-end product vision and roadmap for TPS Distribution, ensuring it is grounded in partner value, commercial outcomes, and long-term platform health across the UK and European markets.

 - Take accountability for the distribution P&L, using data and commercial insight to prioritise what gets built, when, and why - balancing revenue growth with partner retention.

 - Work closely with the Sales and Account Management organisation to ensure product strategy actively supports partner acquisition, retention, and revenue performance.

About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity.

The Community team focuses on finding exceptional power users of our tools and turning real usage into stories and signals that shape both product direction and how the world understands OpenAI. We do that by learning directly from users, then working together to package insights and use cases into formats that can travel: playbooks, webpages, launch assets, event series, and clear guidance on how people actually use our tools.

About the Role

The Head of Community, EMEA,will lead OpenAI’s community presence across the region and be responsible for setting and evolving an evidence-based Community strategy in markets, including hiring local community leads and managers .

The role is responsible for how we create trusted relationships with power users and translate those relationships into participation, insight, enablement, and stories across the region. They will partner with senior leadership to recommend where Community can have the greatest impact across EMEA, laddering up to company and country level priorities.

Immediately, they will oversee our Student Collective https://openai.com/student-collective/ motion in EMEA markets, including working with our global team, global agency and hiring Student Community Managers and coordinators in markets. They understand how to combine thoughtful relationships with programs that can reach many more people. They are comfortable building the first relationships themselves, identifying what makes them valuable, and developing a team that can sustain that quality as the work grows.

OakNorth's lending business is scaling across the UK and US, and we need a Sales Enablement Lead to join our growing Commercial Strategy team.

As Europe’s number one rail travel app, we serve millions of active customers every week across the UK, France, Italy and Spain, and our platform is central to a seamless, end-to-end travel experience.  - Partner closely with Sales, Partnerships and Finance, as well as Data Science, Design and Engineering, to bring new business lines to market and help them scale.

 - Identify new monetisation opportunities based on customer needs, market trends and competitive insight.

 - Share monetisation best practice across the wider product team, helping to set a high standard for the discipline.

 - Experience working in high-growth, multi-market consumer tech environments.

 - An interest in experimentation and optimisation, with a focus on achieving measurable results.

 - Experience collaborating with data scientists, designers, engineers and commercial colleagues, balancing different perspectives while keeping sight of the goal.

 - A pragmatic, collaborative approach, comfortable making considered decisions and bringing new ideas to the table.

title: Partner Programme Delivery Lead
description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. 
 We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.
 After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and combine their pensions with us. 
 With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!
 We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️
 📍UK Remote (with essential travel to our global offshore sites) | 💰£41,300 - £52,250 + Incentive Awards + Benefits ✨ 
 Our Global Ops Team ⭐️ 
 At Monzo, our customers should receive great service regardless of where it is delivered. Successful partner programmes depend on understanding what is happening in practice and completing the detailed work required to move from an agreed plan to a delivered outcome.
 The Partner Programme Delivery Lead exists to investigate the operational reasons behind thematic issues and drive the detailed delivery of agreed projects and workstreams. You will work with data, customer interactions, operational processes, teams and partners to uncover root causes, test assumptions and turn agreed actions into measurable results.
 Delivery is expected at every level within the pillar. In this role, most of your time will be spent in the detail of investigation and execution, understanding the operational reasons an issue needs solving and completing the work required to drive the solution forward.
 You may own a defined workstream within a larger Manager-led programme or independently deliver a smaller project where the direction, scope and intended outcome are already clear.
 🔑 You’ll play a key role by... 
 Investigation and root cause analysis 
• Thematic scope & root cause assessment: Investigate systemic partner-wide issues within agreed focus areas, testing hypotheses to isolate root causes from symptoms and determining whether issues are genuinely thematic or belong within specific domain ownership.
• Quantitative data analysis: Analyse multi-source operational datasets—including customer outcomes, complaints, quality scores, and workflow metrics—to spot underlying trends, exceptions, and performance patterns.
• Qualitative field research & journey auditing: Conduct on-site process shadowing, customer journey reviews, and direct interviews with frontline partner and Monzo teams to evaluate actual operational practices against intended process design.
• Evidence synthesis & impact documentation: Triangulate quantitative and qualitative findings to identify structural drivers (tools, policy, capability, or operating model), clearly documenting root causes, customer impacts, and required next steps.
 Detailed project and workstream delivery 
• Workstream planning & direct execution: Own the end-to-end delivery of assigned projects and workstreams, translating strategic approaches into detailed delivery plans (milestones, owners, dependencies) and actively executing hands-on tasks to drive momentum.
• Cross-functional & partner alignment: Serve as the day-to-day operational contact across Global Ops, GCOO, and partner teams—leading regular working sessions, setting clear delivery expectations, and constructively challenging missed commitments.
• Risk governance & record management: Proactively identify and resolve risks, issues, and dependencies early, escalating material blockers while maintaining transparent, accurate delivery records and baseline progress tracking.
• Operational readiness & BAU handover: Ensure implementation readiness, monitor post-launch performance to verify intended outcomes materialise, and support stabilisation through to formal transition into business-as-usual.
 Insights, recommendations and business cases 
• Insight synthesis & evidence auditability: Translate complex investigation findings into root-cause insights and actionable solutions, maintaining a robust evidence trail to validate strategic recommendations and decisions.
• Business case & operational analysis: Author business cases for smaller initiatives and supply detailed analytical inputs—covering costs, benefits, risks, and customer impacts—for Manager-led strategic proposals.
• Product & Tech process optimisation: Deliver operational analysis for Product and Technology proposals, evaluating system enhancements and process simplifications to optimise service delivery.
• Leadership communications & stakeholder papers: Draft clear updates, briefing papers, and executive presentation materials to synthesise analytical data and drive leadership decision-making.
 Team and portfolio contribution 
• Portfolio mobility & cross-functional collaboration: Partner closely with leads on strategic initiatives while retaining full ownership of assigned workstreams, flexibly deploying capacity across the portfolio as business priorities evolve.
• Proactive risk & insight generation: Identify emerging risks, operational patterns, and areas for investigation, sharing key learnings to refine future program design and global estate decisions.
• Pillar standards & capability development: Drive continuous improvement by establishing consistent analytical and workstream frameworks across the pillar, while proactively expanding expertise in outsourced operations, partner management, and data analytics.
• Global on-site engagement: Travel periodically within the UK and internationally to support on-site investigations, partner discovery, mobilisation, transitions, and operational stabilisation.
 🤩 We’d love to hear from you if… 
• Essential experience independently delivering defined

 You will work directly with partner account teams and risk leads, as well as colleagues across Global Ops, Operations, TPRM and specialist teams. You will independently own defined areas of partner risk delivery, investigate concerns and help partners embed Monzo’s expectations across every location and country we serve.
 As Partner Risk Delivery Lead , you will independently operate the Partner Risk Management framework set by the Partner Risk Manager.
 You will own agreed delivery areas from planning through to completion, maintain accurate records and evidence, challenge where standards are not met and escalate material concerns. The Partner Risk Manager will remain accountable for the overall strategy, standards, governance and material risk decisions.
 🔑 You’ll play a key role by... 
 Risk records, controls and monitoring 
• Maintain an accurate and joined up record of partner risks, controls, requirements, evidence, owners, actions, subcontractors and dependencies across the global partner estate.
• Support RCSAs and other risk assessments by gathering evidence, maintaining the partner risk position and ensuring changes in services, locations, controls or dependencies are reflected promptly.
• Coordinate the day to day delivery calendar for control reviews, evidence updates, assurance activity, resilience testing, reporting and agreed remediation deadlines.
• Deliver proportionate control reviews outside formal independent effectiveness testing, working with control owners and partners to confirm that controls remain fit for purpose, are understood and are operating as intended in practice.
• Identify controls that are unclear, outdated, inconsistently applied or no longer appropriate for the service being delivered. Agree routine actions within your delegated scope and escalate more material concerns to the Partner Risk Manager.
• Maintain partner risk indicators, control status, evidence refresh dates and agreed thresholds. Investigate unusual trends, missing information or emerging themes and turn your findings into clear actions or escalations.
• Apply the established framework consistently while recognising differences between partner locations, the countries where work is delivered and the countries and customers being served. Flag where local requirements or operating conditions require specialist interpretation.
 Partner assurance and on site reviews 
• Coordinate Global Ops input into TPRM supplier assurance activity, gathering complete evidence, operational context, known concerns and the appropriate operational contacts within agreed timescales.
• Work directly with partner account teams and risk leads to explain Monzo’s requirements, obtain supporting evidence, review agreed controls and drive actions through to completion.
• Review evidence critically, challenge incomplete or unclear responses and decline proposed issue closure where the agreed standard has not been met.
• Agree routine actions, accountable owners and target dates with partner and internal teams, maintaining clear records and escalating barriers or material delays.
• Maintain the records and supporting evidence from standard operational checks completed during Global Ops partner visits, including practical observations of physical access, desktop security and local control execution.
• Travel periodically to partner locations and independently complete more detailed operational risk reviews, prioritised according to partner criticality, incidents, control concerns and assurance findings.
• Ensure these reviews complement formal TPRM assurance rather than duplicating a full supplier audit, engaging TPRM where specialist advice or formal assurance is required.
• Maintain organised and accessible evidence so Global Ops remains ready for TPRM assessments, second line reviews, Internal Audit, External Audit, compliance assurance and relevant regulatory requests.
 Issues, incidents and remediation 
• Maintain a complete view of open partner risk issues, control gaps, assurance findings and remediation actions, ensuring owners, dates, dependencies and required closure evidence are clear.
• Own the detailed risk workstream for material partner caused or partner wide incidents, capturing the risk and control implications, coordinating specialist input and maintaining actions through to closure.
• Work with the relevant operational or relationship owner, who will continue to lead the delivery response, while ensuring the associated risks, controls and evidence requirements are fully understood and managed.

title: Customer Program Manager, Executive Briefings
description:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role
 Anthropic's Executive Briefing program brings senior leaders from our most strategic customers together with our spokespeople, product leaders, and researchers. As a Program Manager, Executive Briefings, you will run the program at one of our briefing centers and help build the global operating model that ensures an exceptional and consistent experience across the globe.
 You will be the main program lead for your location and own briefings end to end: qualification and intake, agenda design, speaker selection, and day-of execution. You will set the objectives and design for each agenda and develop it jointly with Sales. You will also be the local account teams' go-to partner on how to use a briefing to move their most important opportunities forward.
 You will manage the global workstream and set the standard every center follows, so customers get the same quality of briefing wherever they meet us. This is a highly cross-functional role. You will work with regional GTM leadership and the Office of the CCO on account selection and program strategy, with Product Marketing on content, with Solutions on technical deep-dives and demos, with Anthropic's executive bench on sponsorship and participation, and with Workplace, Security, and Revenue Operations on the experience and systems behind every briefing. You will be comfortable running every part of a briefing yourself and maintaining tight alignment with internal stakeholders.
 Key responsibilities
• Own the Executive Briefing program at your location: the local calendar, capacity planning, the request and intake process from Sales, and operating SLAs, applied against global criteria and regional allocation
• Work with regional GTM leadership to decide which strategic accounts receive a briefing each quarter, hold the qualification bar, and proactively surface accounts that should be engaged
• Lead discovery with account teams before each briefing to understand the customer's objectives, business context, and stage of evaluation, and turn that into a tailored agenda
• Own agenda design and co-own agenda development with Sales for every briefing, including the narrative arc, discussion topics, speakers, and demos
• Build and manage the speaker bench for your location: identify, source, and match speakers to briefings, run prep, and manage capacity so no one is over-asked
• Own day-of orchestration and the customer experience standard at your center, in partnership with Workplace on logistics
• Contribute to the playbooks, tooling, and best practices that let the program scale consistently across centers while allowing for regional nuance
• Share intake and triage on a rotation across time zones so every request gets a decision within the defined SLA
• Maintain one source of truth for criteria, lead times, and process so account teams get one answer
• Own measurement and reporting for your center and contribute to global reporting on briefing volume, capacity and allocation, strategic-account coverage, and program-influenced pipeline and expansion
• Onboard and coach briefing team members and contractors across locations
 Minimum qualifications
• Experience running executive briefings, customer events, or a comparable program for senior external audiences
• Program management skills, including intake and prioritization, capacity planning, and managing multiple concurrent programs against SLAs
• Experience designing agendas and facilitating discussions with C-level or other senior customer audiences
• Experience building processes, playbooks, or tooling that help a program operate consistently
• Ability to track, report on, and communicate program metrics such as volume, coverage, and pipeline influence
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to partner credibly with field leadership, executives, and internal subject matter experts
• Work on site at your briefing center when briefings take place
 Preferred qualifications

• Experience with CRM and reporting tools such as Salesforce, and with connecting program activity to pipeline and expansion outcomes

ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a commercially-minded Account Manager to join our Mid-Market Account Management Team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help grow and expand our existing customer base and be part of the Customer Growth & Expansion team as we scale. If you're excited about strategic account management, obsessed with customer outcomes, know how to unlock expansion across complex organisation, you love nurturing relationships, identifying growth levers, proving ROI, and are passionate about spend management, then this is the opportunity for you!




WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO 

You’ll report to our Senior Sales Manager, Account Management and work closely with teams in Customer Success, Deal Desk, Pricing and Enablement. Our team of 16 is highly collaborative and dedicated to delivering value and growing our existing customer base. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Sales, Support, Product and Marketing to ensure success.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As an Account Manager, you will:

 - Own a dedicated book of business from a purely commercial perspective, focusing heavily on a land-and-expand revenue model through cross-selling, upselling, and driving overall account growth 

 - Identify and close expansion opportunities within your book of business, securing new entities, teams, and product capabilities aligned with evolving customer needs.

 - Work hand-in-hand with Customer Success teams, who focus on customer adoption and retention, allowing you to stay fully focused on driving revenue and commercial outcomes.

 - Build deep relationships with key decision-makers (senior finance, procurement, and operations stakeholders) to understand their strategic initiatives and uncover whitespace opportunities.

 - Use MEDDICC (or similar framework) to rigorously qualify upsell and cross-sell opportunities, ensuring forecast accuracy and high deal velocity.

 - Showcase new product features, integrations, and advanced workflows. Leverage customer success stories, usage data, and ROI metrics to proactively pitch new functionality and quantify value.

 - Create custom proposals and business cases aligned with commercial goals and customer budgeting cycles, leading commercial conversations to ensure terms reflect the value Pleo delivers.




WHAT YOU BRING 

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

 - A solid understanding of value-based selling and consultative approach

 - Skilled in contract negotiations and building business cases linking features to value

 - Strong understanding of qualification methodologies (e.g., MEDDICC)

 - A passion for solving problems with a solution-oriented approach

 - Data-driven, goal-oriented, and accurate forecasting ability

 - Strong commercial acumen and ability to navigate senior stakeholders

 - A background in SaaS Account Management or Customer Growth with a proven track record of expansion revenue and high net revenue retention

 - Complete fluency in English


WHY IS THIS ROLE A GOOD FIT FOR YOU

This role is a good fit for you if:

 - You are naturally curious and driven to map out complex organisations, identifying white space where Pleo can solve a genuine business need.

 - You get a rush from closing upsells by proving ROI and prefer driving proactive growth over simply waiting for a renewal.

 - You use frameworks like MEDDICC to keep deals on track and can easily show a CFO how tech features translate into financial value.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

 - You view Account Management solely as responding to support tickets or handling administrative renewals rather than proactively hunting for expansion opportunities and driving revenue.

 - You require a rigid, unchanging playbook to succeed. We are scaling fast, which means processes evolve and you’ll need to be comfortable building the plane while flying it.

 - You prefer simple, single-point-of-contact relationships. This role requires multi-threading across Finance, IT, and Procurement in mid-market organizations.
   
   


HOW YOU’LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE 

In your first 6 to 12 months at Pleo, you’ll:

 - Lead targeted account whitespace analysis to drive impact in your assigned market segment.

 - Collaborate with Product and Marketing to improve feedback loops that influence our mid-market product roadmap.

 - Grow your skills in complex commercial negotiation and value engineering, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale




THE LOCATION


Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Working collaboratively, you will leverage data, customer insights, and operational expertise to seamlessly embed vulnerability, accessibility, inclusion, and bereavement considerations into product and service design. You will take proactive ownership of complex strategic projects and use independent judgement to navigate ambiguous escalations, shape treatment strategies, and identify emerging risks. Ultimately, you will ensure that changes deliver equitable customer outcomes while maintaining strong standards of risk management, governance, and regulatory compliance.

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.



We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.




JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

Lead Lived-Experience Research: Own the Signposting Standard and collaborate with the Research team to capture lived experiences, turning best-practice insights into clear cross-functional recommendations.
You have a deep understanding of VAIB principles and the barriers vulnerable customers face, driven by a strong commitment to improving customer outcomes through meaningful external collaboration.

You have proven experience managing external relationships, going beyond relationship-building to set clear objectives, build trust, and hold both internal and external stakeholders accountable for delivering measurable benefits.

You have experience evaluating partnership effectiveness using data and customer feedback, and are highly skilled at translating external expertise and lived experiences into practical, actionable recommendations for teams across Monzo.
You have a strong grasp of due diligence and risk management, ensuring all external partnerships are supported by rigorous governance and robust, accurate documentation.

title: Product Director - Partners & API
description:
London 
 Full-time 
 In office 4 days/week 
• Do you have a background in partner channels, integrations or API products?
• Do you want to help reach SME customers through software partners?
• Do you want to build the platform that partners and developers build on?
 Who We Are 
 Modulr is the payments automation platform that streamlines money movement with accuracy, control and reliability, built to scale. We process more than 200m transactions and over £180bn in payment value on an annualised basis, and we're trusted by over 6,000 businesses from fast-growing SMEs to global enterprises.
 We automate how money moves into and out of a business (payroll, supplier payments, spend management and payment collection) through a single platform, connected to the accounting and payroll systems finance teams already use, and underpinned by principal memberships of Visa and Mastercard and direct access to central bank infrastructure.
 As a regulated payments provider with over a decade of experience, we're the platform finance teams trust to run mission-critical operations. Modulr is backed by PayPal, FIS, General Atlantic, Blenheim Chalcot, Frog Capital and Highland Europe, with over 400 employees across London, Edinburgh, Amsterdam and Mumbai.
 Find out more about us on our website.
 What You’ll Do 
• Set the product strategy for the Platform and API capability, including the public API surface, versioning, developer experience and documentation.
• Own the partner programme, covering integrations with accounting, payroll and software platforms, partner onboarding, certification and commercial terms.
• Build and prioritise the partner roadmap, with the aim of reaching SME customers through integration partners rather than high-cost direct marketing.
• Define the API product portfolio, including access tiers, rate limits, sandboxes and usage-based pricing, with Finance and Commercial. Set API standards for security, reliability and backwards compatibility with Architecture and Quality Governance.
• Own partner-sourced and API revenue, track partner health, adoption and API reliability, and report them to the executive team. Within 12 months, the top partner integrations have a named owner and joint roadmap, and partner-sourced revenue is tracking to plan.
• Lead, coach and develop the product managers in your area.
• Work closely with the Product Directors for External Experience and Internal Experience.
 Who You Are 
 What you’ll need
• 7 or more years in product management, including at least 3 in a senior or director role in B2B payments, fintech, banking or B2B software platforms.
• Proven experience selling through or building partner channels, such as integration partners, marketplaces, resellers or embedded distribution.
• Experience owning an API product, including developer experience, documentation, versioning and API commercial models.
• A track record of owning revenue or margin outcomes, with partner and channel economics you can explain clearly.
• Hands-on experience using AI to improve product discovery, decisions or delivery, with sound judgement on where it fits in a regulated financial services business.
 Nice to haves
• Experience with accounting, payroll or HR software ecosystems.
• Experience with embedded finance or banking-as-a-service platforms.
• Hands-on familiarity with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth and developer tooling.
 What We Offer You 
• Share Options – We offer a Company Share Option Plan (CSOP), giving you the opportunity to benefit from any increase in share value in the event of a sale, merger, or flotation.
• Bonus – Our annual discretionary bonus, paid in May for the previous year, is based on both company and individual performance.
• Flexible benefits – £1000 to spend on benefits to suit you, including private medical insurance, gym membership, dental etc.
• Wellbeing app – confidential, on-demand access to therapy, coaching, counselling, management training or mindfulness sessions with accredited professionals, with company-funded hours and top-up options available.
• Holidays – 33 days annual leave (including bank holidays) plus your birthday off. In the UK, Christmas Day, Boxing Day, and New Year’s Day are fixed holidays. You can choose the remaining days to suit your personal schedule.
• Learning opportunities – Our two-day onboarding programme, ModStart, helps equip you for success. Learning doesn’t stop there; we’ll continue to support your development through various channels.
• Company-Wide Events – Participate in collaborative and engaging events with colleagues across the business.
• Bike to work / E-bike scheme 
 ModInclusion 
 At Modulr, we’re committed to building a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture where everyone feels they belong and can bring their whole self to work. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds as we believe it’s the right thing for our people, our business, and the community we operate in.
 By submitting your CV, you consent to us using your personal data to assess your application, contact you, or share your CV with relevant hiring managers. You can request removal of your data at any time by emailing peopleops@modulrfinance.com, though this will withdraw you from consideration for the role.

title: Manager, Strategy & Transformation (Corporate Development)
description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.
 If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.
 Engagement Manager, Strategy & Transformation (Corporate Development) 
 Ebury London Office — Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week 
 The Opportunity 
 Ebury is a global fintech serving businesses that trade and scale across borders. We are growing quickly and moving from a delivery-led organisation to a platform-led one: one operating model, one standard of client experience, across nearly 70 cities and a growing number of licensed entities.
 That shift is a genuinely hard strategy and operating-model problem, and the people who solve it need to sit close to the CEO and the Executive Committee. Corporate Development is where that work lives.
 We are looking for a former engagement manager from a top-tier strategy consulting firm who is ready to stop advising on transformations and start owning one. You will define the problem, lead the analysis, design the answer and then drive it into the business, with the numbers attached to your name.
 This is a role for someone who is tired of handing over the recommendation and wants to own the outcome.
 You'll work closely with:
• 
 The Managing Director, Corporate Development, with regular exposure to the CEO and Executive Committee
• 
 Functional leaders across Operations, Compliance, Finance, Sales, Product, Technology, Data and Legal
• 
 Regional leadership teams and, over time, the management teams of acquired businesses
 What you'll do 
 Lead transformation programmes end to end
• 
 Own the full arc from problem definition to measured business impact, beginning with client onboarding
• 
 Map the current state: cycle times, drop-off, rework, manual intervention, cost-to-serve, and where value is lost
• 
 Look at the process across customer segments and jurisdictions, and separate genuine local requirements from legacy habit
• 
 Design the target operating model, build the business case, sequence the change into something deliverable, and track whether it landed
 Shape corporate strategy
• 
 Take on the open-ended questions the CEO and ExCo need answered: where to play, how to prioritise investment, how to structure the organisation to scale
• 
 Build the fact base
• 
 Prepare Board and ExCo materials that lead to decisions rather than discussion
 Lead integration
• 
 Run integration workstreams across operating model, systems, people, clients and regulatory permissions
• 
 Own Day 1 readiness and the 100-day plan: what must be true, by when, and who owns it
• 
 Track synergy delivery against what the deal underwrote and escalate early when it slips
 What success looks like (12–18 months) 
• 
 The transformation of a key process is delivered, with a measurable and attributable improvement in cycle time, conversion and cost-to-serve
• 
 You have led at least two further strategic programmes to measured impact, and the changes have held
• 
 Functional leaders treat you as a partner they call early, not a reviewer they manage around
• 
 You are trusted to lead an integration independently and represent Ebury with an acquired management team
• 
 Your analysis is used in decisions at ExCo and Board level and holds up under challenge
 Why this role 
• 
 Direct access. Regular work with the CEO and ExCo on the questions that matter most to the company.
• 
 Real ownership. You will be accountable for outcomes at a scale and speed that is difficult to find in an advisory firm.
• 
 A transition with a path. A route from advisory into a senior in-house leadership role in a fast-growing, regulated, global fintech.
• 
 Exposure to two disciplines. Operating-model transformation and post-acquisition integration, both of which are rare to see from the inside.
• 
 Backing. Ebury is supported by a major global banking shareholder and has been growing consistently since 2009.
 Who we are looking for 
 We are looking for someone with real consulting craft and the agency to operate without a partner above them defining the work. Fintech, financial services, payments or M&A experience is helpful but is not required. We would rather hire the best problem-solver and teach them our industry.
 Must-have:
• 
 5–9 years of experience in strategy consulting, including at least 1 year as an engagement manager (or equivalent) at McKinsey, Bain, BCG or a comparable top-tier strategy firm
• 
 A track record of leading complex, multi-workstream engagements from problem definition to executive-level sign-off
• 
 Strong analytical and quantitative skills: structured problem solving, business case and financial modelling, advanced Excel, comfort working with imperfect data
• 
 Executive-grade written and verbal communication, including the ability to run a room of senior stakeholders
• 
 Degree from a top academic institution in a numerate or analytical discipline; MBA or equivalent welcome but not required
• 
 Fluent English, with day-to-day collaboration across global commercial, technology and Legal, Compliance and Risk teams
 Nice-to-have:
• 
 Experience in operations, operating-model or transformation work, ideally including a post-merger integration engagement
• 
 Exposure to financial services, payments, FX or other regulated sectors
• 
 Experience redesigning regulated processes such as onboarding, KYC or credit
• 
 An additional European language (Spanish, Portuguese, French, Dutch, German or Italian)
 Core Capabilities 
• 
 Structured Problem Solving: breaks open-ended questions into a clear workplan; sizes the opportunity before designing the fix.
• 
 Executive Presence: earn

title: Vulnerability Strategy Manager
description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. 
 We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.
 After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and combine their pensions with us. 
 With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!
 We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️
 📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£51,200-64,700 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨
 Our VAIB team⭐ 
 Making money work for everyone is what we do at Monzo, but it only counts if it works for the people who need support the most. Our Vulnerability, Accessibility, Inclusion and Bereavements (VAIB) team is dedicated to breaking down barriers across the bank. We make sure that whether a customer is vulnerable, disabled, excluded, or experiencing a bereavement, they get a product and a service that is empathetic, accessible, and built entirely with them in mind.
 🔑You’ll play a key role by… 
 As VAIB Strategy Manager at Monzo, you will lead and develop a high-performing team of Strategy Analysts dedicated to improving vulnerability, accessibility, inclusion, and bereavement outcomes. You will act as the bridge between overarching strategy and execution, translating business priorities into data-driven programs that deliver exceptional customer experiences. By collaborating closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will ensure VAIB considerations are deeply embedded into all products and services while maintaining strict regulatory compliance and governance. Ultimately, you will balance empathetic people leadership with rigorous operational discipline to continuously identify emerging opportunities and drive meaningful change for our customers.
• Lead and Develop Talent: Coach and build a high-performing, engaged team of Strategy Analysts, driving recruitment, knowledge-sharing, and a culture of accountability that aligns with Monzo’s core values.
• Drive Strategy and Delivery: Translate VAIB priorities into clear, actionable projects and oversee the implementation of customer-centric treatment strategies, expertly balancing team capacity with strategic and regulatory demands.
• Leverage Data for Improvement: Monitor customer journeys and performance metrics, utilizing both quantitative and qualitative insights to identify emerging trends, resolve gaps, and make evidence-led recommendations with Strategy Leads.
• Champion Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner seamlessly across Operations, Product, Risk, Data, and Engineering to ensure VAIB considerations are deeply embedded into wider business initiatives and customer touchpoints.
• Manage Risk and Governance: Work closely with Risk and Compliance partners to design, document, and operate robust controls, ensuring all team activities strictly adhere to internal governance and external regulatory expectations.
• Resolve Complex Escalations: Act as the primary escalation point for complex customer, operational, or regulatory issues, guiding the team through ambiguity to reach appropriate and proportionate outcomes.
• Lead Through Change: Own and cascade crucial business communications and leadership updates, effectively supporting stakeholders through process changes while identifying emerging opportunities for continuous improvement.
 🤩 We’d love to hear from you if… 
• You have deep subject matter expertise in vulnerability, accessibility, inclusion, and bereavement (VAIB), applying key legal and industry standards (e.g., Consumer Duty, Equality Act, WCAG) to proactively reduce barriers and champion exceptional customer outcomes.
• You are a values-driven leader with a proven track record of building motivated, high-performing teams through coaching, clear feedback, and a strong commitment to continuous professional development for both yourself and your team.
• You are highly organised and adaptable, with the ability to manage competing priorities, allocate team capacity, and translate strategic goals into structured programs of work that are successfully delivered and monitored.
• You can interpret customer insights and operational data to make evidence-based recommendations and sound decisions, particularly when navigating complex or ambiguous regulatory and operational challenges.
• You have a strong grasp of risk, governance, and control environments, paired with excellent communication skills to influence stakeholders, manage formal actions, and confidently guide your team through organisational change.
 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!
 🙌 What’s in it for you 
 💰 £51,200-64,700 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance
 ⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. 
 📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.
 🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. 
 ➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits .

title: Team Lead, Global Alliance Partnerships
description:
This is Adyen 
 Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 
 For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster. 
 At Adyen, over 40% of deals that go live involve a partner. The Partnership’s Team five year plan is to continue to accelerate our growth curve and get that number well north of 70% while having an impact in every stage of the merchant lifecycle.
 To help drive this five year mission we’re looking for an experienced and motivated leader to join our EMEA Commercial Partnerships team. This is a critical role in realizing our mission, where you will be instrumental in iterating our culture and building an amazing team environment that creates future leaders for Adyen.
 You will mentor, coach and maintain a high performance bar for a team of commercial partner managers who are responsible for establishing strategic relationships with GSIs, SIs (System Integrators), Payments Consultants and Private Equity firms to drive significant channel revenue and accelerate the onboarding of new clients. You are comfortable streamlining team operations, encouraging effective cross-functional collaboration, and engaging with executives at all levels and cutting the noise so your team can focus on excellent execution.
 The ideal candidate will possess a deep, comprehensive understanding of how these firms operate, win, and deliver transformation services. You are comfortable streamlining team operations, encouraging effective cross-functional and cross-continental collaboration, and confidently engaging with senior executives both internally and throughout our partner ecosystem.
 What You'll Do 
• Define the mid-to-long (1-3+ year) strategy for EMEA Alliances that supports Adyen’s business objectives and aligns with our global Partnerships org 
• Prioritize EMEA strategy and individually help deliver on the highest impact opportunities to deliver on commercial goals
• Apply your broad expertise in partnerships enabling the broader team to make business decisions that support the wider global alliances team
• Serve as a senior executive stakeholder, providing strategic and consultative advice to influence the payments strategy of our partners
• Work closely with Marketing, Pillar, Product and Sales teams to ensure effective collaboration
• Lead a high performing team of 4-8 people, providing guidance, motivation, constructive feedback & coaching, and constantly striving to raise the bar
• Create an inspiring and collaborative team environment with an open communication / feedback culture.
• Set clear individual and team goals focused on revenue growth. Report on performance and metrics at an executive level
• Retain talent and recruit new team members in line with the Adyen Formula 
 Who You Are 
• At least 3-5 years experience in managing teams and building executive level enterprise relationships
• You are an experienced alliances professional (6+ years) who deeply understands how GSIs and consultancies win and deliver large-scale transformation services.
• An energetic self-starter with proven commercial edge, a track record of delivering results and the ability to build long term relationships
• Comfortable and excited by being responsible for commercial goals and creating a measurable impact for the business
• Can balance strategic thinking with focused execution 
• Comfortable owning messages from senior leadership and fostering an environment of accountability & ownership 
• Excited to lead and manage time-sensitive, cross-functional initiatives in a fast-paced, highly entrepreneurial and collaborative environment
• An excellent communicator and team player with strong leadership skills and technical understanding
 Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Adyen 
 We actively seek different perspectives to sharpen our ideas. Our unique culture is a product of our diverse backgrounds and experiences. No matter who you are or where you’re from, you’re welcome to be your true self at Adyen. 
 If you need accommodations or support during the recruitment process to perform at your best, you’ll have the opportunity to let our team know in your application. We encourage people from all backgrounds and abilities to apply. 
 What’s next? 
 Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility. 
 This role is based out of our London office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.
