title: Early Careers Program 2027 🚀
description:
Blockchain is connecting the world to the future of finance. As the most trusted and fastest-growing global crypto company, it helps millions of people worldwide safely access cryptocurrency. Since its inception in 2011, Blockchain has earned the trust of over 90 million wallet holders and more than 40 million verified users, facilitating over $1 trillion in crypto transactions.
 Kickstart Your Career at Blockchain.com!
 At Blockchain.com , we're building the future of finance, and we're looking for the next generation of talent to help us get there!
 As one of the world's leading cryptocurrency platforms, we're passionate about making financial services more accessible, transparent, and efficient through blockchain technology.
 Our 2027 Early Careers Program in London is designed for ambitious students, recent graduates, and early-career professionals eager to learn, take ownership, and gain hands-on experience in one of the most exciting and fast-moving industries.
 Whether you're passionate about technology, financial markets, business, or people, we want to hear from you!
 About the Program
 Our London Early Careers Program offers the opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals, contribute to meaningful projects, and gain exposure to the rapidly evolving world of cryptocurrency and digital assets.
 We're looking for emerging talent across a wide range of teams, including:
• 
 Engineering & Technology: Software Engineering, Infrastructure, Data, Security, and Product Development.
• 
 Trading & Financial Markets: Quantitative Trading, Market Making, Trading Operations, and Research.
• 
 Sales & Business Development: Institutional Sales, Partnerships, and Business Development.
• 
 Marketing & Growth: Digital Marketing, Brand, Social Media, Growth, and Communications.
• 
 Finance & Business Operations: Finance, Accounting, Treasury, Analytics, and Strategy.
• 
 People & Human Resources: Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, and People & Culture.
• 
 And more! Opportunities may also arise across Product, Compliance, Legal, and other business functions.
 Specific opportunities will depend on business needs, team availability, and your skills and interests.
 What You'll Do
 Depending on your team, you will have the opportunity to:
• 
 Work on real projects that contribute directly to Blockchain.com's products, operations, and business objectives.Collaborate with talented colleagues across different teams.
• 
 Develop practical skills through hands-on experience, mentorship, and continuous learning.
• 
 Bring fresh perspectives, ideas, and creative solutions to business challenges.
• 
 Gain exposure to the cryptocurrency ecosystem, blockchain technology, and the future of financial services.
• 
 Take ownership of your work and make a tangible impact from day one.
 What We're Looking For
 We're looking for people with curiosity, ambition, and a willingness to learn. You don't need to be a crypto expert to join us!
 Ideally, you are:
• 
 Currently pursuing a university degree, a recent graduate, or at the beginning of your professional career.
• 
 Interested in blockchain technology, cryptocurrency, financial markets, or the broader fintech ecosystem.
• 
 Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• 
 A strong communicator who enjoys collaborating with others.
• 
 Analytical, curious, and eager to solve problems.
• 
 Comfortable taking initiative, learning from feedback, and adapting to new challenges.
• 
 Available to work from our London office.
 Relevant technical knowledge, academic experience, or previous internships may be beneficial depending on the team, but we value potential, attitude, and motivation just as much as experience. 
 What We Offer
• 
 Real-world experience: Work on meaningful projects with genuine business impact.
• 
 Learning & development: Gain practical experience and learn directly from industry professionals.
• 
 Global exposure: Collaborate with colleagues across our international teams.
• 
 Mentorship & feedback: Receive guidance and support as you develop your skills.
• 
 Career opportunities: Build your professional network and explore potential longer-term opportunities within Blockchain.com.
• 
 A dynamic environment: Experience life at the intersection of technology, finance, and innovation.
 Ready to Build the Future With Us?
 If you're excited about starting your career in crypto, exploring new challenges, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you!
 Apply to our 2027 Early Careers Program in London and tell us a little about yourself, your interests, and the areas of Blockchain.com you'd be most excited to explore.
 Applications will be reviewed based on available opportunities, and our Talent Acquisition team will reach out if your profile aligns with an upcoming opening.
 Your career starts here. Let's build the future of finance together. 🚀

We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, and apprenticeship. Blockchain makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

 Do you want to help solve the world's toughest problems with data and AI? This is what we do every day at Databricks.
 This role presents a unique opportunity to expand Databricks’ presence within a set list of customers across top consumer and distribution companies in the UK and Ireland.
 Reporting to the Enterprise Sales Leader, the Enterprise Account Executive is an experienced sales professional focused on driving adoption of Databricks to unlock new value streams and expand Enterprise accounts. Passionate about solving business challenges, you excel at initiating and advancing conversations to value delivery using a defined methodology and playbook.
 Skilled at selling innovation, you guide deals to accelerate decision-making, articulate product value to customers and partners, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to grow existing accounts across a diverse territory.
 The impact you will have:
• The opportunity to work with cross-functional teams to build out Databricks solutions for customers within consumer and distribution industry verticals
• Assess your accounts and develop a strategy to identify and engage all buying centers
• Use a solution-based approach to selling and creating value for enterprise growth accounts 
• Be comfortable switching between technical stakeholder and business buyer personas, in order to connect the customers challenges to business value through the entire sales cycle
• Identify and secure tech wins to grow consumption while managing longer, complex sales cycles
• Track all customer details including projects, purchase time frames, next steps, and forecasting in Salesforce and supporting softwares
• Map the whitespace opportunity across your defined territory, and use methodology to identify the most viable use cases in each account to maximise Databricks’ impact
• Orchestrate and work with internal and external partner teams to maximise the impact on your ecosystem
• Build value with all engagements to promote successful negotiations to close point
• Be customer-focused by delivering technical and business results using the Databricks Intelligence Platform

• Strong closing experience and evidence of exceeding sales quotas
• Sales experience within cloud data and AI software, ideally linked to open source technology
• Track record of driving consistent high activity to generate, develop & accelerate pipeline
• Familiarity with sales methodologies and playbooks (e.g. ICP, territory and account tiering, MEDDPICC, Powerbase and value selling)
• Ability to navigate and be successful in a fast-growing organisation
• Experience driving successful adoption of usage-based consumption services (SaaS) and co-selling with AWS, Azure and Google Cloud teams 
• Methods for co-developing business cases and gaining support from C-level Executives

title: Operations Representative Compliance
description:
Our Global Structure 
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
 About the team 
 We’re looking for a motivated individual to join our Deliveroo Rider Onboarding/Compliance Team. This is an exciting and fast-paced team that plays a key role in helping applicants become Deliveroo riders, ensuring we maintain a strong and available fleet to meet customer demand. This is the perfect opportunity to join a dynamic, growing company and develop your operational skills in a supportive environment.
 About the role 
 Reporting to the Rider Onboarding and Compliance Team Lead(s), you will work closely with the wider Rider Operations and Compliance teams. Your responsibilities will span the entire rider lifecycle, from ensuring a smooth and efficient onboarding experience for new applicants to proactively maintaining the compliance of our active riders. You will manage key stages of the onboarding process, support applicants through their journey, and help maintain accurate pipeline pacing to meet supply needs across various markets. In addition, you will be responsible for managing compliance pipelines to reduce rider downtime and ensure Deliveroo is compliant with local laws at all times. This role requires strong attention to detail, a focus on process excellence, and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-moving environment.
 Work full time in the London Office hybrid working policy 3 days in the office and 2 days at home.Different shifts possibilities:
• Monday - Friday with some Week-end work ( 1 week-end every 6-8 weeks)
• Tuesday-Sunday,
• Wednesday-Monday ,
• Thursday-Tuesday ,
• Friday-Wednesday ,
 Your main responsibilities will include:
• Support applicants through the onboarding stages by ensuring smooth movement through application flows
• Work towards weekly hiring targets by managing onboarding flows effectively, and proactively identify and escalate any bottlenecks or blockers that could impact achievement of targets.
• Launching new markets, being involved in everything from the rider apply page to hitting our target
• Work with our Vendors and ensure they are assigned to tasks daily, and perform weekly QA Work to targets, maintaining a high and level of productivity and quality
• Escalate issues with proposed solutions and share feedback with your manager
• Willing to help out on a range of admin tasks
• Help all our markets with their supply pipelines and flows
• Accurately load riders to compliance sweeps to ensure we have valid and compliant rider information and documentation
• Respond to internal and external compliance escalations
• Ensure the Rider Compliance Team process and training documentation is up-to-date
• Collaborate with the Compliance Team to identify opportunities for reducing inefficiencies within our processes
• Collaborate with the broader Rider Compliance Team to achieve KPIs and targets 
• Proactively identify, investigate and take appropriate actions to mitigate rider compliance risk within our fleet or processes
 Requirements
• You are proficient in written and spoken English
• You have strong communication skills
• You are highly organised with excellent attention to detail
• You are comfortable following structured processes and escalating where guidance is needed
• You are a team player and collaborate well with others
• You are adaptable and can work effectively in a fast-paced environment
• You are motivated, consistent, and eager to learn
 Desirable
• Experience using Saleforce and Gsheets
• Proficient in French, Dutch, Italian 
 Benefits
 25 days holiday, paid bank holidays, pension, life, health & dental insurance
 Deliveroo Plus subscription, benefits including discounted gym subscription, wellbeing
 Employee assistance program, Cycle-to-work scheme
 Company-paid team meals and nights out
 Online learning courses
 Why Deliveroo?
 Our mission is to be the definitive food company. We are transforming the way the world eats by making food more convenient and accessible. We give people the opportunity to eat what they want, as they want it.
 We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, seeking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy, we are always looking for new ideas.
 Diversity, Equity and Inclusion 
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
 We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.
 If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
 If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!
Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness .

title: Account Executive - EMEA Specialist
description:
Who we are 
 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 
 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 
 About the role: 
 Samsara is seeking a high-impact, strategic seller to lead the go-to-market execution for our newest frontiers in Connected Equipment. As an Enterprise Specialist (Overlay), you will partner with our Account Executives (AEs) to build deep partnerships with our largest, most complex accounts. You aren't just selling a tool; you are pioneering GTM, ensuring our customers realize continuous value from new products as a part of the overall platform.
 This specialist reports into the VP of Sales, EMEA and will be aligned by segment and product. AEs on the team are charged with accelerating the growth of one or more new product(s) and will be incentivized on quarterly product sales targets mapped to mainline sellers in the segment. Product Specialist sellers drive growth through strategic, high-value deal executing and enabling the segment overall to be successful.
 This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom.
 You should apply if: 
• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
• You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’re meeting with a VP of Operations in waste management; the next, you’re diving into the logistics of a global food distributor. You seek to understand the "unit of value" for every customer.
• You build genuine, high-stakes relationships: Our customers operate in "boots-on-the-ground" industries. They value earned trust and partners who understand their operational realities.
• You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 
• You are a team Player: In an overlay role, your success is tied to the success of the broader account team. You lead through influence, not just authority.
 In this role, you will: 
• Architect deals that align Samsara’s new products value with customer use cases to provide maximum value and return on investment
• Co-generate new product pipeline with ADRs/AEs across high propensity to buy accounts
• Drive strategy and pilot/trial success 
• Provide commercial insights and pricing benchmarks often for unique set of competitors in the market
• Partner with GTM and Product to feed back insights and help shape roadmap
• Build frameworks, assets and insights that scale across the sales org
• Travel 20%+ to meet customers where they physically operate and to advance solutions and deals
• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices 
 Minimum requirements for the role: 
• 5+ years in complex, full-cycle Enterprise sales.
• Proven Track Record: Consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts with £500k+/€500k+ ARR transactions.
• Deal Complexity: Demonstrated success navigating 6- and 7-figure deals involving multiple stakeholders (Legal, Procurement, InfoSec, and C-Suite).
• Entrepreneurial Agility: Experience selling new products where the playbook is still being written.
 An ideal candidate also has: 
• Experience working in a specialist/overlay co-selling with a mainline AE team.
• Second language experience in French or German at business-level proficiency.
 Total Rewards 
 At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
 Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
 Flexible Working 
 At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. title: AI & Innovation Lead, G&A
description:
At Sanity https://sanity.io/, we’re building the future of AI-powered Content Operations. Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like SKIMS, Figma, Riot Games, Anthropic, COMPLEX, Nordstrom, and Morning Brew use Sanity to power and automate their content operations.



In this role, you’ll join the Finance team as the AI & Innovation Lead, G&A, reporting to the CFO. You’ll sit in Finance with a dotted line to our Director of Systems Engineering. This role sits at the intersection of G&A operations, data, workflow automation, and AI. You bring the domain depth: you know how G&A teams actually work, where their processes and systems break, and which manual work eats their week. You’ll start with Finance, then quickly extend into People and the rest of G&A. You’ll prototype the fix yourself, vibe-coding agents, apps, and workflows on Sanity’s own platform and AI tools. Systems Engineering and the Data team back you on architecture, security, and production hardening, so your ideas become systems the business can rely on. If you’re a G&A operator who has already started rebuilding your own work with AI, and you want to do that for an entire G&A organization, this role is for you.




WHAT YOU WOULD DO:

 - Shape and execute on the AI first transformation roadmap for G&A: map where G&A teams lose time, and decide what to build, buy, or automate first.

 - Run intake, prioritization and stage-gates for the G&A transformation portfolio, with clear owners, decision rights and a regular exec review cadence

 - Prototype agents, apps, and automations yourself on Sanity’s platform and AI tools, then partner with Systems Engineering to take the ones that work to production.

 - Translate G&A processes into clear specs and prototypes for engineering: data flows, system of record, controls, edge cases, and what “done” looks like.

 - Build for trust through controls, audit trails, access management, data quality, and human-in-the-loop review, so G&A teams and auditors can rely on what you ship.

 - Partner with the Data and IT teams on the G&A systems and data infrastructure, connecting the systems G&A and our data warehouse together.

 - Drive adoption across G&A: train teams, document the paved paths, and help each function run more of its own work with AI and retire legacy manual processes.

 - Measure impact through hours saved, cycle times, error and exception rates, adoption, AI evals, and stakeholder feedback.

 - Help shape the practices and culture of a young Systems Engineering team with a strong bias toward practical impact.




ABOUT YOU:

 - Remote in North America (SF preferred).

 - Deep G&A domain knowledge, ideally 8+ years in Finance, Accounting, People ops, or business operations at a software company.

 - Hands-on experience applying AI to G&A work, for example leading an AI program for your function, automating a core process, or building agents for your own team.

 - Comfortable building prototypes with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar). You don’t need to be a software engineer, and you’re not afraid of a terminal.

 - Understands APIs, data flows, and how G&A systems connect: what moves between the ERP, HRIS, CRM, contract tools, and warehouse, and where it breaks.

 At Lighthouse, we’re on a mission to revolutionize commercial strategy as hospitality’s most powerful AI platform. We take the world's largest hotel data network and transform it into real-time intelligence that drives action. We don't just deliver insights; we empower businesses to make decisions that move revenue.

Our 850+ teammates across 35 countries aren't just building software—they are leveraging cutting-edge AI to help hoteliers be the first to act. Tens of thousands of hotels across 185 countries trust Lighthouse to execute their commercial strategy, including every one of the top 15 global chains and thousands of independent hotels that consistently outperform their markets. With Lighthouse AI, the intelligence gets deeper. Decisions get smarter. Actions get faster. We help hoteliers be first to act.

title: Customer Experience Specialist
description:
The role & impact

As a CX Specialist, you will be a passionate Xero brand ambassador , responsible for providing timely, high-quality support and guidance to customers of all levels, from beginners to experts. This includes providing support for accounting and bookkeeping queries. You will make an impact by demonstrating empathy, actively listening, and delivering consistently high customer satisfaction across all contact channels.

 

The work requires resilience and adaptability. You will manage customer inquiries through to resolution, accurately recording case details in the case management system (e.g., Salesforce), and escalating unresolved issues appropriately while keeping customers informed. Success is measured by achieving quality and productivity targets and ensuring best-in-class customer experiences.

 

The team & how they connect

The Customer Experience (CX) team works collaboratively to provide proactive and reactive support to a diverse range of Xero users globally, including small business owners, bookkeepers, and accountants. They are dedicated to delighting customers and demonstrating the value Xero brings to their businesses , working 24/7 across various channels.

 

The team is currently working on

 - Providing high-quality support across all channels, such as phone, email, and chat.

 - Proactively engaging with customers to help them maximise the benefits of Xero.

 - Making proactive and reactive outbound calls to manage and resolve customer inquiries.

 - Staying up-to-date with Xero product changes, training, and accurately recording case details.

 

Where and how you can work

The Customer Experience (CX) team operates a hybrid working arrangement, requiring three days per week in the office. You will be able to work form home for the remaining two days. Please note, the initial training period for this role will require you to be fully in the office five days a week.

 

We are looking to add Customer Experience Specialists to our team who will work one of the following schedules:

 - Monday through Friday, 11:30AM - 8PM, 7:00AM - 3:30PM

 - Tuesday through Saturday, 11:30AM - 8PM, 7:00AM - 3:30PM

 - Sunday through Thursday, 11:30AM - 8PM, and 7:00AM - 3:30PM 

 

Please note that the anticipated start date will be in March 2027. There will also be an evening pay supplement for shifts ending at 8:00 PM.

 

Here are some of the things we are looking for, for this role

 - You bring prior experience in a service environment, having demonstrated the ability to meet service levels and quality targets.

 - You possess proven problem-solving and resolution skills, showing commitment to following through and resolving customer problems.

 - You can communicate clearly and concisely, both written and verbally.

 - You will have comfort and confidence in making proactive and reactive outbound calls.

 - You demonstrate initiative, self-management skills, and flexibility, embracing challenges and adapting quickly to change.

 - You are a proven team player with a willingness to assist and collaborate with other team members.

 

Apply even if your experience isn't a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team.

title: KYB Operations Lead, UK
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE 

Ramp is scaling fast in the UK. Our European operations team (Europs) onboards UK and EU businesses across Ramp’s own regulated entities and our card-issuing and payments partners. We’re a small team of specialists that runs on frontier AI tooling. Everyone builds and maintains their own automations and apps, and we’ve taken daily processes from hours to minutes. We’re hiring a senior UK KYB expert to raise the bar on how we onboard UK businesses. You’ll work the hardest cases and make the final first-line call, own escalations with our partners, keep the UK queue moving, and build the fixes that stop the same problems coming back. This is a hands-on role for someone who would rather redesign a broken requirement than work around it, and who is as comfortable in a difficult ownership structure as in the data on why cases get stuck.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Work the hardest UK onboarding cases yourself and make the final first-line (1LoD) call: complex ownership structures, EDD, PEP and adverse-media outcomes, and anything that needs judgement rather than a checklist

 - Keep the UK queue moving: spot what’s stuck, decide what matters most, and pick up cases yourself through leave and spikes in volume

 - Be the senior expert the UK team leans on: share your reasoning on hard cases, raise the bar on decisions, and help everyone get better at building as well as reviewing

 - Own escalations with our card-issuing and payments partners, including recurring failures, disputed or unnecessary requirements, and turning each fix into a repeatable playbook

 - Set the standard for customer-facing onboarding communications: clear requests, fast follow-ups, no avoidable back-and-forth

 - Build fixes, not workarounds: automate your own work with AI, and work with Product and Engineering to remove requirements customers shouldn’t have to meet twice

 - Define and track operational metrics (caseload by provider, time to close, handling time) and use them to decide what to fix next

 - Write consistent, evidenced 1LoD decision standards that hold up to partner sample reviews and second-line scrutiny
   
   


WHAT YOU NEED

 - 5+ years in KYB / onboarding / financial-crime operations at a UK fintech, EMI, PI or bank

 - Practical working knowledge of the UK regulatory framework for EMIs/PIs: MLRs 2017, JMLSG guidance, and FCA expectations for customer due diligence

 - Strong judgement on complex business customers: multi-layer ownership, overseas parents, trusts, PEPs, and knowing when to escalate

 - Clear written communication, both with customers and in documented case decisions

 - Demonstrated use of AI tools in your day-to-day work to go faster or do better work, with concrete examples

 - A bias to fix the process rather than just work the queue

 


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Line management of operators or analysts (strongly preferred)

 - Experience working with card-issuing, BaaS or payments partners on onboarding (e.g. partner due-diligence requests, sample reviews)

 - Safeguarding / client-money reconciliation experience

 - Writing requirements for Product and Engineering teams

 - EU onboarding experience or a second European language






BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

 - Flexible PTO

 - Centralized home-office equipment ordering

 - Health and wellness stipend

 - Budget for intra-office travel

 - Weekly coffee stipend




UNITED STATES

 - 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

 - One Medical annual membership

 - 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

 - Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

 - Pet insurance

 - In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

 - Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)
   
   


CANADA

 - Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

 - Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

 - Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

 - Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health




UNITED KINGDOM

REFERRAL INSTRUCTIONS

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

 


OTHER NOTICES

 About us 
Risk Ledger is building a network of connected organisations that defend each other against supply chain cyber attacks. Instead of chasing suppliers with one-off questionnaires, our customers connect with them, share security information, and see risk across their whole supply chain.
 Organisations such as British Airways, BAE Systems and the NHS use Risk Ledger to understand and reduce third-party risk. Every new connection makes the network more valuable for everyone on it.

title: Professional Services, Program Manager
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 
 An overview of this role
 As a Professional Services Program Manager at GitLab, you will lead the delivery of complex, multi-workstream services engagements for some of our largest and most strategic customers. You will help customers turn transformation goals into clear execution plans by bringing structure, visibility, and accountability across interconnected projects. Working closely with customer stakeholders and GitLab team members, you will guide programs from planning through delivery while building trusted relationships across executive, technical, and delivery teams. In this role, you will define and apply a strong delivery methodology grounded in agile and project management best practices, communicate that approach clearly, and keep teams aligned on milestones, dependencies, and outcomes. This is a strong opportunity to shape how customers adopt GitLab at scale and help them realize meaningful business value through effective program leadership.
 What you'll do
• Lead delivery of multi-workstream professional services engagements for large and strategic customers
• Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders, including executive leaders, program and project managers, engineering, development, and security teams
• Develop and apply a delivery methodology that uses agile and project management best practices, and communicate how the methodology will be used throughout the program
• Create and continuously communicate program roadmaps, dependencies, milestones, and deliverables across connected projects
• Manage stakeholder expectations and secure approval on major milestones, decisions, and delivery plans
• Define program strategy, including business justification, expected benefits, in-scope and out-of-scope work, timelines, schedules, resources, stakeholders, and success criteria
• Establish core program structures such as RACI charts, work breakdown structures, communication plans, and escalation paths
• Work closely with Engagement Managers and Regional Delivery Managers to support program scoping, review delivery assumptions, and help improve project management processes through quarterly objectives and key results (OKRs)
 What you'll bring
• Experience leading complex programs with multiple interdependent projects, stakeholders, and timelines
• Strong skill in program planning, forecasting, reporting, and communicating delivery metrics clearly to internal and external stakeholders
• Ability to organize, monitor, and manage long-term project budgets, schedules, risks, and dependencies
• Proven ability to build collaborative relationships with customers and partner effectively with Engagement Managers, Architects, and delivery teams
• Working knowledge of agile and other project management approaches, with the judgment to apply the right structure to different customer needs
• Ability to develop long-term plans that support customer adoption, transformation, and successful delivery outcomes
• Comfort leading program-level meetings and driving progress across multiple workstreams
• Willingness to complete GitLab Project Management certification within 2 months of starting in the role
 About the team
 On our Professional Services team, we help customers adopt GitLab effectively by turning strategy into structured delivery. As Program Managers on our team, we bring clarity to large, complex engagements by coordinating people, plans, and processes across multiple workstreams. We work closely with customers, Engagement Managers, Architects, and delivery leaders to create practical plans, manage risk, and keep programs moving toward agreed outcomes. Because we operate in an all-remote, asynchronous environment, we value clear communication, strong documentation, and ownership. This role is well suited for you if you enjoy building order in complex environments, guiding stakeholders through change, and helping customers make progress on meaningful transformation efforts.

title: Programme Manager - UK Government
description:
What we’re all about.

It isn’t often you get to be part of a tech company that, since 2016, has been innovating the data analytics market in ways no-one else can. Our technology started out in FinTech, helping tackle serious criminal activity. Now, its potential is virtually limitless. Working at Quantexa isn't just intellectually stimulating. We’re a real team. Collaborating and constantly engineering better and better solutions. We’re ambitious, we think things through and we’re on a mission to discover just how far we go. Nearly half of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We’re made up of people from 47 nationalities who speak over 20 languages. As a diverse mix of individuals, we make one big unstoppable team.

If our incredible culture sounds like you, we’d love you to join us.



The opportunity.

As a Programme Manager, you will lead the end-to-end delivery of complex Quantexa programmes for customers using our Decision Intelligence platform across multiple business use cases, workstreams or releases.

You will own the overall success of the programme, providing strategic oversight across all projects and initiatives, driving business value realisation, shaping and prioritising the delivery pipeline, owning programme P&L, and enabling sustainable account growth through effective delivery.

You will be part of the Project Management practice, a global network of project and programme management professionals within Quantexa, a group designed to support your career development and ensure you fulfil your full potential.

As well as working with some of the largest and most prestigious organisations in the world, you will work hand in hand with our delivery partner network, including the big four consultancies and major systems integrators.



What you’ll be doing.

 - Provide strategic direction and leadership for complex Quantexa programmes, setting clear objectives, priorities, success measures and an executable roadmap aligned with the customer’s strategic objectives and desired business outcomes.

 - Establish the programme organisation, governance forums, roles, controls and reporting, coordinating dependent projects, workstreams, releases, with clear accountability across Quantexa, customer and partner delivery teams.

 - Drive successful outcomes, owning value realisation and ensuring the programme delivers measurable business outcomes for the customer in the most effective and commercially sustainable way.

 - Own an integrated programme plan covering scope, milestones, dependencies, resources, critical path, risks and benefits, identifying roadblocks early, managing programme level risks and escalationsand driving corrective action.

 - Build trusted relationships with customer executives, programme sponsors and delivery leaders, influencing decisions and maintaining alignment across Quantexa, the customer and delivery partners.

 - Enable customers and partners to build the capability to adopt, operate and extend Quantexa successfully.

 - Take full ownership of P&L and commercial performance including budgets, forecasts, revenue, margin, contracts, change control, , resource and capacity planning and the cost-effective use of people and resources.

 - Embed Quantexa delivery methodologies, quality controls and best practice across the programme, ensuring solutions are operationally stable and aligned to current product capabilities and recommended technology.

 - Set the culture for collaboration, accountability and wellbeing, coaching Project Managers and cross-functional leads and resolving delivery tensions constructively.

 - Provide concise executive reporting on programme status, outcomes, financials, risks, decisions and key metrics, with clear recommendations and actions.

 - Identify opportunities to expand customer value and support account growth through delivery, improve delivery effectiveness and strengthen Quantexa’s programme management capability through lessons learned and reusable practice assets.



What you’ll bring.

 - You are an accomplished programme management professional with a strong track record of leading and delivering large, complex technology or data programmes spanning multiple teams, workstreams and releases.

 - You have led customer-facing delivery in a consultancy, professional services, systems integrator or enterprise technology environment and are credible with senior executives and programme sponsors.

 - You have strong commercial judgement and experience owning programme P&L and commercial performance, including budgets, forecasting, margin, contracts, change control and resource and capacity planning.

 - You understand the full software delivery lifecycle and the factors required to deliver secure, high-quality and operationally stable enterprise platforms.

 - You are experienced in Agile delivery and can apply the right blend of Agile, iterative and programme controls across multiple teams and dependencies.

 - You are adept at leading in complex ecosystems involving customer teams, product and engineering functions, consulting teams and delivery partners., establishing clear accountability and alignment across organisations.

 - You communicate with clarity and gravitas, can simplify complex topics, influence senior stakeholders and challenge constructively to drive decisions and achieve the right outcome.

 - You bring strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills and can navigate ambiguity, make effective trade-offs and resolve complex delivery and commercial challenge while maintaining momentum and control.

 - You are a collaborative, emotionally intelligent leader who inspires others, develops talent and creates an inclusive, accountable culture.

Who we are 
 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 
 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

 Renewals are the core of a SaaS company's revenue. You own renewal targets for Samsara's Digital Mid-Market segment: setting customers up for success while maximising financial results.  At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
 Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
 Flexible Working 
 At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. 
 Belonging at Samsara 
 At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. title: Strategic Client Manager
description:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

Our largest fleet clients have the most vehicles, the most data and the most to gain from our connected proposition. As our Strategic Client Manager, you’ll be the main face of Flock for them, from multinationals and well-known brands to fast-growing sector leaders, and you’ll own those relationships end to end.

Nearly all our business comes through brokers, so you’ll sit at the centre of the client, broker and Flock relationship, working closely with our Broker Development Managers and teams across the business. You’ll build our corporate client management approach from scratch, from account reviews and performance reporting to bringing claims, safety, underwriting and finance together for our biggest clients. You’ll report to our Head of Distribution and use AI day to day to prepare for meetings, understand accounts and improve reporting. Success means our clients stay with us and recommend us to others.

 


WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 - Own the relationship with a portfolio of Flock’s largest fleet clients, becoming their primary point of contact and developing a strong understanding of their business.

 - Build and run our corporate account management approach: client reviews, reporting, relationship cadence and account planning.

 - Work closely with brokers and our Broker Development Managers to deliver a coordinated experience for every large corporate client.

 - Bring together teams across Flock, including claims, safety, underwriting and finance, to resolve client questions and issues quickly, and build strong relationships with key stakeholders across client organisations.

 - Identify retention risks early and create clear plans to protect our most important accounts.

 - Help shape and improve Flock’s wider client service proposition, including account reviews, portal engagement, safety support, claims and reporting, feeding client feedback back into the business.

 - Use AI in your day-to-day work, from account research and meeting preparation to query management, meeting summaries and client reporting.

 


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - Strong experience within the insurance industry, with a clear understanding of the broker–client–insurer dynamic and the judgement to know where you add value, without duplicating the broker’s role, creating confusion or adding unnecessary layers for the client.

 - Experience in a client-facing role such as insurer account or deal management, broker account management, claims relationship management or a similar position.

 - A proven track record of managing important client relationships and delivering strong retention or customer satisfaction, with the confidence to work with senior stakeholders across clients, brokers and internal teams.

 - Strong commercial judgement. You can identify when an account is at risk, understand what matters to the client and build a plan to retain them.

 - Energy and ownership. You’re comfortable picking up a problem, finding the right people and driving it through to a solution.

 - Confident using technology in your daily work, curious about how it can help you work faster and deliver a better client experience.

Nice to have: experience with large, complex or multi-site corporate clients, Commercial Motor Fleet or fleet risk and safety experience, or exposure to claims or to building a client service proposition.

 


BENEFITS

 - 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

 - Share Incentive Plan 📈

 - Workplace Pension 💰

 - Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

 - Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

 - Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

 - £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

 - £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

 - 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. This role is expected to be field based rather than office based, so visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that’s a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

title: Implementation Manager
description:
ACCURX IS WHERE CONVERSATIONS HAPPEN WITH AND ABOUT PATIENTS IN THE NHS

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that connects everyone through communication.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient, has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices and 68% (and growing!) of NHS Trusts.

Our platform now powers Total Triage https://www.accurx.com/primary-care to manage patient demand, and Self-Book https://www.accurx.com/booking that lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires https://www.accurx.com/questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail https://www.accurx.com/accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe https://www.accurx.com/scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.



GAMECHANGING, RIGHT? HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL BE GETTING STUCK INTO TO MAKE IT WORK

As an Implementation Manager, you’ll be the one making sure our most ambitious tools actually land and stick in Secondary care. You won't just be ticking boxes on a rollout list; you’ll be leading the charge on high-impact transformations, like helping clinicians and admin teams move over to Accurx Scribe https://www.accurx.com/scribe. You'll spend your time figuring out how these tools fit into the daily lives of clinicians, making sure they aren't just "installed," but are genuinely making things better for everyone.

 - Driving deep transformation: Leading big-scale rollouts for complex products like Scribe, making sure we’re not just doing the basics but fundamentally changing how healthcare is delivered.

 - Strategic boundary-setting: Standing firm on implementation plans and managing commercial expectations to ensure we deliver sustainable solutions without overcommitting.

 - Owning the AI journey: Becoming the go-to expert on our emerging AI features, taking full ownership of how they are introduced to practices and scaled across the country.

 - Closing the feedback loop: Reviewing practice cohorts 6-9 months after go-live to see if they’re actually using the product as intended and figuring out how we can make it even better.

 - Scaling with smarts: Using our internal AI dashboards to handle the "heavy lifting" of data, so you can focus on the human side of implementation while we automate the repetitive bits.

 - Raising the bar: Constantly looking for ways to improve our processes—if something isn't working or could be more efficient, you’ll have the autonomy to change it.

 


YOU SHOULD APPLY IF...

 - You’ve been around the block with big rollouts: You have solid experience managing complex implementations in a fast-paced business and you know how to keep a project moving.

 - You’re a "driver," not a "passenger": You don't wait to be told what to do; you dive into the context, spot the problems, and take the lead on solving them.

 - You can hold your own: You’re comfortable having tough conversations with stakeholders and can stay firm on what’s achievable

 - You’re a natural communicator: You can explain technical or complex changes in a way that feels clear, simple, and actually exciting for the people using them.

 - You’re relentlessly resourceful: When you hit a roadblock, you don't just stop - you find a creative way over, under, or through it.

 - You care about the "why": You’re motivated by the idea of fixing healthcare communication and want to see the real-world impact of your work on clinicians and patients.




WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

You’ll join a high-performing team on a mission to solve healthcare productivity, building a platform used by around 300k NHS staff every week, supporting the care of over 50 million NHS patients every year. We set a high bar, move fast, and give people the ownership and support to do the best work of their careers

 - £45,000 - £60,000 salary, plus a discretionary recognition bonus for exceptional performance and impact, nominated by managers and awarded by our leadership team

 - Equity: £15,000 in equal share options, so you share in the value you help create

 - Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

 - Built for collaboration: We are an office-first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office for a minimum of 3 days a week

 - Close to our users: Regular hackathons, plus dedicated time to visit GP practices and other healthcare settings to see first-hand how our products are used

 - Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

 - Support at home: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support

 - We have our very own chefs: Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches, plus a weekly sweet treat

 Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.
 Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.
 Operations at Brex 
 Operations is the backbone of Brex’s mission to power businesses through our Intelligent Finance Platform. We own credit, fraud, money movement, and payments, protecting our customers and our company. From product operations that ensure flawless launches to scalable systems that drive innovation and precision, we operate at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and customer success. If you want to work at the heart of the business, Operations is where you belong.
 What you'll do 
 As a Fraud Strategy Associate, you’ll own the end-to-end integrity of Brex’s fraud and risk ecosystem across credit, deposit, and card payment rails. You'll find patterns, trace root causes, and build the detection logic, automations, and reporting that keep fraud in check without adding friction for customers. You’ll design your own solutions, see fraud across every product vertical, and partner with Risk, Data Science, Engineering, and Product to build prevention into the product itself. 
 Where you'll work 
 This role will be based in our Salt Lake City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work! 
Responsibilities 
 Strategic Analysis & Detection 
• Data Mining: Use SQL and Python to mine large-scale data, and apply LLM-based tools to detect and automate the identification of fraudulent patterns across credit, deposit, and card payment rails.
• Vendor and Rule Optimization: Design and refine automated detection logic to proactively mitigate risk while maintaining a frictionless experience for legitimate customers.
• Emerging Threat Intelligence: Stay ahead of industry trends and regulatory shifts to rapidly deploy new defensive strategies against novel fraud vectors.
 Operational Excellence & Process Ownership 
• Workflow Architecture: optimize the internal processes for fraud investigations, ensuring operational discipline, case visibility, and high-fidelity documentation.

title: Senior Product Operations Associate
description:
We’re Capital on Tap 👋
 💳 Capital on Tap started because small businesses were underserved. Big banks were slow, their products weren't fit for purpose, and small business owners often couldn't access what they needed. We set out to fix that. 
 Today we're a financial platform - not just a credit card company. We offer a best-in-class business credit card, SME-focused spend management platform, a savings product that hit £1 billion in funds within its first year, and a growing suite of tools and financial products that make running a small business easier. 
 1,000+ employees, £20bn in annual card spend, 200,000+ customers, 17,000+ Trustpilot reviews averaging 4.7 stars, and we're profitable. We’ve done a pretty good job so far, but we’re just getting started! 
 Product at Capital on Tap 
 Our Product team sits at the heart of everything we build. We move fast, work closely with engineering, and obsess over outcomes for our customers. Product Operations makes sure what we launch works as intended, for our customers and for the teams that run it. 
 The Role 
 We are looking for a Product Operations Senior Associate to join our growing Product Operations team. You will own the day-to-day operational health of your product area - Cards, from launch readiness through to post-launch performance. You will work closely with Engineering, Compliance, Customer Operations and external partners to drive new initiatives and improvements, so that our customers get the best possible account. 
 You will be a trusted operator across multiple workstreams: independently leading large projects, mentoring more junior team members, and starting to shape Product Operations processes and ways of working. 
 What You'll Be Doing 
• Owning the rollout of a new products and features end to end, from planning through to a stable, bug-free release 
• Monitoring and analysing product performance data (approval rates, acceptance rates, failure rates, SLA metrics) to identify issues and inform optimisation 
• Lead improvements to our authorisation and authentication performance, resolving merchant acceptance and clearing issues so our card is accepted globally 
• Support global card programme management in partnership with scheme partners (Visa), including global stock management. 
• Owning relationships with key partners, internal and external, including scheme partners and vendors, and being trusted by the senior management team to do so 
• Generating your own strategic ideas for pilots and workstreams, and influencing the right stakeholders to back them and get them live 
 What We're Looking For 
• 3+ years of experience in product operations, payments operations or a similar role, with a track record of independently leading large projects and owning incidents end to end 
• Deep knowledge of a product area, built from working with customers and researching issues, and the credibility to challenge a Product Manager as an equal 
• Card payments and card scheme knowledge in the debit or credit card industry, ideally with experience of Visa or Mastercard scheme rules 
• Experience owning rollouts from planning to a stable release, with regulatory, risk and compliance sign-off built in 
• Strong analytical skills, using data to make decisions, balance short and long-term trade-offs and push for the right outcomes with evidence 
• Confidence using AI tools to automate repetitive work and deepen research 
• Excellent stakeholder and vendor management skills, with the trust to own relationships with key partners and to communicate with senior stakeholders 
 Our Hiring Bar 
 Alongside the role-specific experience above, every Product Operations candidate is assessed against a shared set of traits that we look for regardless of level or product area. 
• Deals with ambiguity: Doesn't need a fully formed brief to start moving. Handles priorities or requirements shifting mid-flight without getting stuck. 
• Data-driven decision making: Uses operational, customer, and performance data to inform decisions, balance short- and long-term trade-offs, and quantify impact on revenue, retention, cost, and risk. 
• Hungry to learn, no ego: Wants to develop, asks questions and takes feedback well. 
• Organised: Ensure projects run smoothly with close attention to detail on organisation of tasks and owners, confident managing up where necessary to hit deadlines. 
• AI curious: Actively uses or explores AI tools in their day-to-day work, rather than treating it as someone else's job. 
• Strong communication up and across: Confident presenting to all levels of stakeholders, comfortable being challenged, and backs decisions with evidence rather than opinion. 
• Self starter: Moves without waiting to be told or chased. Takes ownership of problems even outside a strict brief. 
• Depth: Goes beyond the surface on their own area. Understands the mechanics, edge cases and trade-offs, not just the headline issue. 
 Interview Process 
• Stage 1, Recruiter screen (30 mins): A chance to learn about the role and company, and for us to understand your background and motivation. 
• Stage 2, Hiring Manager Call (30 minutes): You'll meet the hiring manager. The conversation will cover operational processes, incident ownership, proactive use of data, pilots you have led, payments experience and decision-making under pressure. 
• Stage 3, Case Study Interview (45 mins): with Hiring Manager plus one member of the team. 
• Stage 4, Final interview in the Office (45 mins): You'll meet one or two members of the broader Product team. We'll focus on values, strategic thinking and how AI features in your day-to-day work. 
 Diversity & Inclusion 🌈 
 We welcome, consider and encourage applications from anyone who shares our commitment to inclusivity. Join us in creating a space where authenticity thrives, and everyone can do their best work. 
 Great Work Deserves Great Perks

description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.
 About Us 
 Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. 
 Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. 
 Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. 
 As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. 
 During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. 
 About the Role 
 We’re looking for a Staff Engineering Operations Partner to own how Engineering organises, maintains, and uses its internal knowledge. You’ll join our Engineering Operations partner team and lead Engineering knowledge management in Notion as your primary program. 
 You’ll define what good looks like: a clear information architecture, useful content types and templates, accountable content owners, and documentation that engineers can find and trust. You’ll assess the current state, set priorities, lead the improvements, and establish practices that keep the knowledge base useful as Engineering grows and changes. 
 This is a hands-on role. You’ll combine knowledge management expertise with technical fluency, using AI and automation to improve documentation workflows and reduce manual maintenance. You’ll work closely with engineers, process owners, other EngOps partners, and technical enablement to make standards part of everyday practice. You will own the knowledge management framework and its effectiveness, while partnering with subject matter experts who are accountable for technical accuracy. 
 You’ll also serve as the Engineering Operations Partner for our Engineering Strategy & Operations (ES&O) global group, supporting planning, execution, operational health, and process improvement. Engineering knowledge management will be your dedicated program alongside this partnership. 
 This is a full-time position based in Novi Sad, Serbia.

description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

title: Customer Relations Agent
description:
JUNIOR CUSTOMER RELATIONS AGENT

Full-time, 40 hours a week + a comprehensive benefits package | London office, 5 days a week | Starting January 2027

Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services have made life harder for them, with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe, bringing together payments, business accounts and other business tools with simple technology and real human support. From card payments and business accounts to financing solutions, we help our Members spend less time worrying about their finances and more time doing what they love.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you love helping people and want to make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Mission

We’re looking for warm, positive people to join our Customer Relations team in London and help us look after the local businesses who rely on Teya every day.

As a Junior Customer Relations Agent, you’ll be the voice our Members hear when they need us, helping them by phone, email and web chat. We hold ourselves to a standard we call heartwarming hospitality: every Member should come away from a conversation with us feeling looked after, not processed.

This is a role for someone who loves talking to people and solving problems. You’ll have in-depth training from day one, the support of a team that wants you to succeed, and a clear path to build your career at Teya.

Your responsibilities will include:

 - Help our Members: Answer incoming calls, emails and web chats, guiding Members through our products and services.

 - Solve problems first time: Get to the root of each query and resolve it there and then wherever you can.

 - Handle issues with care: Look after complaints with empathy, and escalate to the right team when something needs specialist support.

 - Keep great records: Keep clear, accurate notes on every interaction, so every Member gets a joined-up experience.

 - Spot patterns: Share recurring issues and trends with your Team Leader, so we can fix problems for every Member.

 - Keep learning: Build strong knowledge of our products and processes through structured training, coaching and feedback.

 - Represent Teya: Deliver the genuine care and hospitality that we want every Member to experience, on every call.

Your Story

We believe great customer service comes from all kinds of backgrounds.

You might have worked in a contact centre, in hospitality, in retail or in another customer-facing role. Or you might be just starting out, with the right attitude and a real desire to help people.

What matters most to us is your attitude, your ability to connect with people and your willingness to learn.

We’re looking for people who bring:

title: Director, Integrated Campaign Strategy & Planning
description:
About AlphaSense: 
 AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com . Come join us. 
 About the Role: 
 AlphaSense has the products, the content, and the customers. We are now transforming how Marketing brings that story to market through strategic campaigns run as a truly integrated effort. We need a leader who has built and led this motion before, at scale and ideally through the pre-IPO to IPO journey, to define, launch and manage this process at AlphaSense.
 As Director of Campaign Strategy, you will define the campaign strategy and framework for the marketing organization and guide cross-functional teams as they build campaigns against it. You will own the thesis, audience, and measurement model for our campaigns, and the strategy that informs channel mix and budget. Your job is to make sure the integrated plan is comprehensive, aligned to the strategy, and executed well across channel owners and journey stages, and you will have the influence and the mandate to hold teams to that standard.
 You will partner with every Marketing team: Product and Solution Marketing, Growth, Demand Gen and ABM, Comms, Brand, Content, International, Influencer, Customer Marketing and Education, Field Marketing and Events, and Marketing Operations to unify our collective efforts and align them tightly to business outcomes.
 Who You Are: 
• 12+ years of experience in high-growth, enterprise B2B SaaS marketing, including significant experience leading campaign strategy or integrated marketing at scale
• A track record of defining and implementing a campaign framework across a large marketing organization, with results you can show
• Experience at a pre-IPO company through IPO is preferred, but not required
• Proven ability to influence and hold accountable cross-functional teams you don’t manage directly
• Experience partnering across Product Marketing, Demand Gen, ABM, Brand, Content, Sales, Customer Success, and other cross-functional teams
• Strong analytical skills and a habit of evidence over assertion: you set targets, measure honestly, and can say how you’ll know it worked
• Strategic judgment to connect business goals to campaign strategy, and channel and budget decisions
• Executive presence and excellent communication
• Fluency with the modern marketing stack and a point of view on using AI to raise the team’s leverage is preferred
• Budget ownership experience is a plus
 What You’ll Do: 
 Own the Campaign Strategy and Framework
• Define the campaign strategy and operating framework for the marketing organization: how campaigns are prioritized, scoped, briefed, planned, launched, and measured
• Turn company priorities, product roadmap, customer insight, and market opportunity into a small number of well-defined campaigns, each with a clear thesis, audience, and success criteria, as well as content and offer strategy
• Set the strategy that informs channel mix and budget allocation, partnering with channel owners who develop to the final plan
