title: Account Executive
description:
COMPETENCIES

Planhat OS is a model-agnostic AI operating system where people and agents work together across the entire customer lifecycle. At its heart is Pi, the world’s first multiplayer customer agent. Think Salesforce, Slack and Claude all in one and Google Cloud has stated that Planhat has built the first next-generation CRM.

We’re 250+ people, profitable, and growing fast. The world’s biggest logos run on Planhat because Salesforce and ServiceNow can’t deliver fast enough.

More specifically, the people who do this well bring:

 - Sales process expertise: you successfully carry revenue responsibility and can craft memorable sales processes tailored to SaaS VP and C-level executives

 - Curiosity: you know it's much deeper than slide decks and swag. You're speaking with a FinTech company and quickly figure out that the CRO wants to reduce churn, and that CS reps need to automate a bunch of tedious tasks

 - Business acumen: you're tech-savvy and a quick learner. You can figure out people's biggest commercial challenges and set them on their way to long-term success

 - Builder mentality: you thrive in uncharted territory. You take initiative, create your own playbooks, and figure out how to get traction

 - High performance: you consistently exceed revenue targets. You're motivated by growth and impact, and you're always looking for a tougher challenge

Before joining Planhat our current Account Executives had experience such as:

 - Proven track records in selling powerful B2B SaaS products, usually at scrappy startups, often starting out as BDR/SDR and progressing quickly to AE

 - Running an effective sales cycle, defining and owning it, from prospecting to closing with VP and C-level executives

 - Revenue responsibility in sales or customer success, exceeding targets and overperforming at fast-growing software companies

 - A strong academic and/or competitive sports background, since this role takes a blend of grit, determination, and commercial acumen


TRAJECTORY

We define and drive Planhat's GTM strategy and sales process. We excel at identifying our buyers' objectives regardless of their role, seniority level, company size, or industry. This means we power the growth not only of Planhat, but of software businesses across our key markets:

 - Tailoring our approach for every person, even when leaders at the same company have unique goals and pain points

 - Leading strategic discussions with the C-suite, diving deep into the product, and ironing out the nitty-gritty details

 - Listening and building trust, understanding what success looks like, handling objections, creating the right onboarding plan, and steering the path to a signed contract


DEFINITION OF SUCCESS

 - You own a revenue target and exceed it quarter over quarter

 - You have a strong pipeline, built through both inbound and self-sourced opportunities, and you own the full sales cycle end to end

 - You are consistently seen as a trusted advisor by your prospects and customers, not just a salesperson

 - You are growing into more senior commercial responsibilities within the team

 - You are actively shaping the culture and playbook of a high-performing AE team at Planhat

title: GTM Systems Lead
description:
ABOUT US

We're Team Granola 👋

Granola is an AI-powered notepad for people in back-to-back meetings. What started as a better way to take notes has become a shared workspace that helps teams capture, organize, and act on what matters.

We're building a product people genuinely love and are fortunate to work with many of the world's most ambitious companies. As we continue to grow, we're looking for a GTM Systems Lead to build the systems and data foundation that Sales, CS and leadership run on.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a GTM Systems Lead to own the technology behind Granola’s commercial team as we scale.

You’ll design, build and run the systems our Sales and CS teams rely on. Our current stack has served us well, but it needs to evolve as the team grows. You’ll take responsibility for how the tools fit together, what we build versus buy, and how information flows between them.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll set the direction of the stack and implement the technical changes that make it work. You’ll work closely with Sales, CS and Data, and report to the Head of RevOps. You won’t be limited to administering a CRM or building isolated automations: you’ll own how the whole system works.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design and evolve the GTM stack. Decide how our Sales and CS systems should fit together, what to build versus buy, and what to prioritise as we grow.

 - Own the technical architecture of our CRM, Attio. Shape its data model, objects, workflows and integrations. You’ll be hands-on with configuration, particularly early on, but routine admin won’t be the sole focus of the role.

 - Build and maintain integrations. Make data flow reliably across Attio and our wider toolset, including Apollo, Cal.com http://Cal.com, Tally and Polytomic, and into the data systems used by the wider business.

 - Own the wider toolset. Assess new tools and vendors, improve or replace what isn’t working, and make sure the stack is useful, reliable and cost-conscious.

 - Find opportunities for automation and AI. Identify work that could be made easier for Sales and CS, and build or collaborate on solutions where they fit the priorities of the stack.

 - Keep systems dependable. Troubleshoot problems, establish sensible governance and documentation, and partner with IT on access and security.

 - Understand how teams work. Get close to Sales and CS workflows so the systems you build solve real problems, not just technical ones.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience designing, building and owning systems used by a growing commercial team. Relevant hands-on experience matters more to us than a particular number of years or experience with a specific CRM.

 - Sound judgement about system architecture, priorities and build-versus-buy decisions—and the ability to explain those decisions to non-technical colleagues.

 - Technical depth beyond administering tools: you’ve built integrations and are comfortable working with APIs, webhooks and code. Experience with SQL, Python or JavaScript would be useful.

 - An understanding of CRM data models, routing, enrichment and the operational work needed to keep data flowing reliably.

 - A willingness to get into the weeds. You’re comfortable doing the implementation yourself while also thinking about how the stack should develop over time.

 - Curiosity about AI-powered GTM workflows, with experience building them a plus rather than a prerequisite.

 - A collaborative, low-ego approach. You can work through messy requests with Sales, CS and Data, challenge assumptions constructively, and ship solutions people can use.

 - You don’t need to have used Attio or every tool in our stack. We’re more interested in what you’ve built, how you think about systems, and how you’d apply that experience here.


ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

We are living in the most exciting time for tool builders since Engelbart's demo in 1968 and we want to assemble the best crew to build this future together. Our compensation philosophy is to hire the best people in the market and pay them accordingly with salary, variable, and equity.

Lastly, we think amazing talent comes from all kinds of life journeys and experiences. If what is written above speaks to you, whether you look like a fit on paper or not, please reach out.

description:
What we're all about.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We're heading in one direction, the future. We’d love you to join us.



The opportunity.

The Quantexa Academy is a key contributor to driving the self-sufficiency and enablement of Quantexa's customers and partners. We achieve this through online learning, instructor-led training and practical technical programmes that help Quantexa users configure, use and implement our award-winning Decision Intelligence Platform. We are looking for someone to join our Academy Team Lead team on a nine-month maternity cover, delivering high-quality technical learning experiences for our colleagues, customers and partners.

In this fixed-term maternity cover role, you will deliver engaging face-to-face and online training, support learners with technical and learning queries, assess learner work and contribute to the continued development of the Academy's technical curriculum. You will act as a key interface between the Academy, learners, clients and partners, working closely with colleagues across Education Services, Cloud, Delivery, Solution Engineering, Technology Account Partners and Alliances.

 - Excellent communication, relationship-building and collaboration skills, with the ability to motivate learners and work effectively with clients, partners, colleagues and stakeholders.

 - Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to balance training, assessment and learner support while adapting to changing programme needs.

 - A proactive, positive and solution-focused approach, contributing to an inclusive and supportive learning environment.



Desirable

 - Experience of maintaining or contributing to technical curricula, training code or learning programs

 - Experience working with cloud-based virtual training environments or VDI setup and issue resolution

 - Knowledge of learning technologies, assessment platforms or Learning Management Systems

 - Quantexa Data Engineer Academy certified



Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

 - Competitive salary & Company bonus

From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.
 SEO Specialist 
 Why We Have This Role 
 People arrive at Qualtrics because they searched for an answer — how to understand what their customers actually want, why their best employees leave, whether a product will land before they build it. Whether they find us depends on whether our site can be crawled, indexed, understood, and cited. That is the work. We run a large site consisting of thousands of pages across multiple languages and regions. Search itself is changing rapidly. An answer surfaced inside an AI-generated response now matters as much as (if not more than) a blue link, and the signals that earn it are not all the same ones that mattered five years ago. This is a senior, individual-contributor role and the only one of its kind on the team. You will own technical search for Qualtrics including site health, structured data and entity signals, and the working relationship with web engineering. You will not be handed a playbook for the AI-search half of it. You will write it.
 How You’ll Find Success 
• You diagnose before you prescribe. You can read crawl data, log files, and Search Console together and tell a symptom from a cause.
• You get things shipped. A technical finding is worth nothing until it is in production. You write requirements engineers respect, you understand why their roadmap looks the way it does, and you argue priority on business impact.
• You quantify. You can put a number on what a fix is worth before you ask anyone to build it, and show what it returned afterward.
• You translate. You explain a problem to an engineer and its business consequence to a marketing leader in the same afternoon, and both leave clear.
• You work well without a playbook. The AI-visibility side of this role is genuinely still in motion. You are comfortable designing a measurement approach, being wrong about part of it, and revising.
 How You’ll Grow 
• You will own a function outright, which is the fastest way there is to build judgment about what actually matters.
• You will build our approach to visibility in AI-assisted search early enough that the work is formative rather than inherited.
• You will work across web engineering, web marketing and localization which is broad exposure for a specialist role.
• You will have the authority to set technical standards the wider marketing organization builds against, and a path toward broader search or web strategy leadership.
 Things You’ll Do 
 Site health and technical foundations 
• Own crawl and index health end to end including crawl budget, indexation directives, sitemaps, robots directives, orphaned pages, broken and redirecting internal links, and all error remediation.
• Own site architecture and internal linking as a system, how authority moves through the site, and whether the pages that matter are being prioritized.
• Run page performance as an ongoing program: monitor Core Web Vitals across page templates, diagnose LCP, INP, and CLS regressions, and drive prioritized actions with engineering.
• Lead technical SEO for migrations, rebrands, domain consolidations, and content deprecations including redirect mapping, pre-launch QA, and post-launch monitoring.
 Structured data and machine understanding 
• Own the structured data roadmap: audit coverage, prioritize by opportunity, and ship in phases.
• Build and maintain the entity model that connects our brand, products, people, and content into something a machine can resolve unambiguously.
• Make sure content hierarchy, markup, and metadata express what a page is actually about to both to search engines and to the retrieval layers behind AI-generated answers.
 International and multi-locale search 
• Own hreflang, canonical strategy, and localized site structure across languages and regions.
• Diagnose and resolve cross-locale cannibalization and duplication.
 AI and generative search visibility 
• Build our approach to visibility in AI-assisted search: how we are found, understood, cited, and represented in AI-generated answers.
• Set crawler policy for AI and LLM agents deliberately, balancing visibility against control.
• Track how retrieval and citation mechanics change, and adjust our technical approach before the impact shows up in traffic.
 Engineering and cross-functional partnership 
• Act as the technical SEO counterpart to web engineering: write specifications, size effort collaboratively, and shepherd work through the backlog to release.
• Embed SEO requirements into CMS templates, component libraries, and the standard pre-launch QA checklist so fixes become defaults.
• Review new page templates, JavaScript rendering behavior, and site releases before they ship.
• Set easy-to-follow, technical SEO standards for web marketing and web engineering partners.
 Measurement and reporting 
• Own technical SEO reporting including what changed, what it was worth and what is next.
• Build monitoring that catches regressions ear

description:
Technical Lead - Global



Location: Bristol, London or Edinburgh (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Level: Technical Lead TL1

Team: Engineering

Contract: Permanent



Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.



About Kaluza



Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.



Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.



With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.



The role

You’ll join the Kaluza Technology community: a large team of product-focused and data-led Product and Platform Engineers working at serious scale.



You can expect to work across many technologies, including AI, Claude Code, Typescript, AWS, Terraform, Kafka and Datadog. We believe our team members should have the possibility to be involved in all aspects of our delivery including development, design, support and testing to name a few. As a Tech Lead, you're one of the most experienced engineers in your team.



Engineers at Kaluza build with AI, and we mean that practically. From your first day you’ll have paid access to Claude Code, with a budget we don’t ration, and MCP access to the systems you need. Our tooling and conventions are evolving quickly, and you’ll have a heavy hand in defining how we build moving forward.



What you’ll do

 - Set the technical direction for your team: be accountable for the solution designs and architecture decisions, work with your team on technical strategy, and assist them through ambiguity over the longer term.

 - Work across the stack over time: depending on the team you’ll work across the interface people use, the services behind it, and the APIs between them, in whatever stack your team runs.

 - Build with AI coding agents as your default: break work down so agents can execute it, direct them, review what they produce as carefully as a colleague’s PR, and maintain the tests and guardrails that let agent-written code merge safely.

 - Own the health of your services: SLOs and SLAs, operational health reviews, post-mortems, and the in-hours support rota, with your turn on the on-call rota alongside the team.

 - Coach the engineers around you: technical guidance for a mix of junior and senior engineers, pairing, and code review that teaches as well as gates.

 - Connect your team to the rest of Kaluza: work with other Tech Leads and Principal Engineers on the wider architecture, and represent your team where platform decisions and engineering standards are made.



What you’ll bring

These are the practices and behaviours we see most in our best tech leads and value deeply, but we don’t expect everyone to tick every single box. If you’re excited by the role and can see yourself thriving here, we’d love to hear from you.



Ideally, you’ll have:

 - Experience leading technical change: you’ve taken a new service or a major architecture change from idea through to running in production, and you can say what you’d do differently.

 - A daily agentic development practice: you build with tools like Claude Code or Cursor, you can walk us through work you’ve shipped this way, and you have views on where agents help a team and where they get in the way.

 - Operational ownership: comfortable deploying with shared tooling, well-versed in SRE fundamentals like SLOs, disaster recovery and platform health monitoring, and used to owning your software in production, including out-of-hours on-call.

 - A coach’s instincts: you’ve mentored and grown engineers at different levels, and you make the people around you better.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and a bias to action: you can deliver against a technical strategy iteratively over months, and you’d rather ship a sound first step than wait for certainty.

 - Strong product sense: you ask why before building, and you can point to times when user feedback or metrics changed what you shipped.

 - Clear communication, especially in writing: designs, specs, PR descriptions and post-mortems that a teammate, a stakeholder or an agent can act on, and the stakeholder skills to work well with Product Managers, Principal Engineers and other Tech Leads.

 - Skills and hands-on experience: with many technologies, including AI, Typescript, AWS, Terraform, Kafka and Datadog.
   

Essential Criteria

 - Hands on experience with API development, Typescript back-end & AWS.

 - Strong application of system and architectural design across a range of deliveries.

 - Highly skilled in overseeing and delivering tangible end-to-end outcomes.



Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

 - Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

 - Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

 - Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

 - Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

 - Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.



Our Perks

 - Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

 - Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

 - Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perk

We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny. 
 Klaviyo , a rapidly expanding NYSE listed enterprise technology company, is revolutionising the way businesses connect with their customers through advanced marketing automation solutions. Our cutting-edge platform empowers companies to create personalized, data-driven campaigns that drive exceptional results. As a leader in the industry, Klaviyo is committed to innovation, customer success, and fostering a collaborative work environment. We are looking for individuals who want to join our dedicated team and help us grow our already impressive customer base in EMEA even further. 
 We're seeking passionate Customer Success Professionals (CSMs) for our new state of the art and dynamic London office who thrive in a hybrid working environment (3 days in the office). Our mission is to exceed customer expectations and drive their growth. We're looking for CSMs who are dedicated to delivering the best experience to our EMEA customers.
 This is an exciting opportunity for someone with a customer-first attitude, strong consultative and technical skills, and a proven track record of creatively solving unique problems in a fast-paced environment. 
 Ideal candidates will have a strong background in CRM, Campaign Management, Data and Analytics, Digital, E-Commerce, or Marketing Technology Solutions. 
 How you will make a difference: 
• Transform workflows by putting AI at the centre, building smarter systems and ways of working from the ground up.
• Be passionate about customer success and establish yourself as the trusted advisor for Klaviyo’s enterprise business.
• Drive positive Net Revenue Retention by mitigating churn risk and identifying opportunities for customer expansion and upgrades.
• Devise customized success plans based on customers' goals and challenges, holding customers accountable for driving action.
• Compose strategies to increase email, SMS, and digital channel revenue for all customers through the Klaviyo platform while driving growth and expansion.
• Proactively review customer performance, address any open issues, and ensure consistent messaging and appropriate escalation.
• Keep customers up to date on product releases and new features.
• Share feedback with Product/Engineering to enhance customer engagement.
• Contribute to a positive team environment of collaboration, customer empathy, equality, and inclusion.
 Who you are: 
• 2+ years of customer success or account management with a track record for building and nurturing relationships with multiple stakeholders on an account at a time.
• An experienced marketer with a background in campaign management, CRM, digital marketing, data, or analytics.
• You’ve already experimented with AI in work or personal projects, and you’re excited to dive in and learn fast. You’re hungry to responsibly explore new AI tools and workflows, finding ways to make your work smarter and more efficient. 
• Familiarity with Marketing Automation technologies.
• A proven track record of advising customers or executing marketing strategies.
• Customer success or account management experience with a history of building and nurturing relationships with multiple stakeholders.
• Experience explaining how to achieve key goals using software with end users.
• A track record of creative problem-solving for customers and end users.
• Comfortable discussing and supporting commercial conversations.
• Thrives in a collaborative environment.
• Excellent organizational and project management skills.
• Excellent communication skills via phone, video conference, and email.
• Curious and eager to learn.
• Adaptable to change and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• Experience with G-Suite, Gainsight, Salesforce, or similar tools.

title: Regional Account Manager Auto (North West)
description:
Our Story
 
Hello there. We’re Zopa.
 
We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com! 
 
We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. 
 
If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife


Please note this role will be based "remotely" but will require regular travel to clients around the North East and Scotland
 
Zopa Auto Finance is expanding its regional team to build stronger dealer coverage across underdeveloped territories. You will own a regional patch, combining new-business development with hands-on account management, and work closely with dealer partners and internal onboarding, commercial, product, operations and risk colleagues.

• Identify and prioritise dealer prospects that fit Zopa Auto Finance’s growth strategy and risk appetite.
• Build a healthy regional pipeline and keep CRM activity, status and next steps accurate.
• Present Zopa’s proposition clearly and guide suitable partners through onboarding.
• Own day-to-day dealer relationships and maintain account plans that improve engagement, quality proposals, volume and long-term value.
• Use performance reviews to identify trends, risks and actions across volume, conversion, credit quality, pricing and customer outcomes.
• Support partners with training, product education and process guidance.
• Resolve partner queries and escalations quickly with internal colleagues.
• Share competitor and regional market insight to support Auto growth strategy.
• Proven sales experience and evidence of winning new business.
• Ability to build trusted B2B relationships and manage a regional portfolio.
• Commercial judgement that considers partner quality and customer outcomes.
• Confidence using data, insight and CRM to prioritise activity and improve performance.
• Organisation, resilience and self-motivation for a field-based role.
• Full UK driving licence and ability to travel regularly across the region.
• Motor finance, dealer finance or regulated commercial experience.
• Experience growing a territory, supporting partner onboarding or managing performance, risk or fraud considerations.
• Knowledge of the North East, Scotland dealer landscape.

title: Creator Programme Executive (12-month FTC)
description:
Contract: 12-month fixed-term
 At Gymshark, Creator Marketing is about building authentic relationships that connect our brand with communities around the world. As an Associate, Creator Marketing, you'll play a vital role in bringing our creator strategy to life by managing talent partnerships, identifying emerging creators, and delivering campaigns that drive impact across your region.
 This is a hands-on role with genuine ownership. You'll be responsible for cultivating strong creator relationships, supporting talent recruitment, and ensuring campaigns are executed seamlessly from planning through to delivery. If you're highly organised, commercially aware, passionate about creator culture, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, this could be the perfect next step in your marketing career.
 WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING: 
• Manage and grow a portfolio of creator and athlete relationships, acting as a key point of contact for Gymshark.
• Build meaningful partnerships with creators across a range of levels, from established talent to emerging micro-creators.
• Support the delivery of talent plans, ensuring contractual commitments and campaign deliverables are met.
• Develop and maintain talent roadmaps, tracking key activations, milestones, and renewal opportunities.
• Oversee the creator lifecycle from outreach and onboarding through to activation and ongoing partnership management.
• Conduct market research to identify new creator opportunities and evaluate potential talent against strategic objectives.
• Maintain recruitment pipelines and talent tracking systems, ensuring data remains accurate and up to date.
• Stay connected to creator, social, and cultural trends, proactively sharing insights and opportunities with the team.
• Execute creator marketing campaigns, coordinating with internal stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered on time and to a high standard.
• Monitor content performance and campaign compliance, escalating risks and challenges where required.
• Contribute to campaign reporting and performance analysis, providing accurate and timely insights.
• Manage administrative aspects of partnerships, including contracts, invoicing, and documentation.
 WHAT YOU'LL NEED:
 Essential Criteria:
• Experience managing relationships with creators, influencers, athletes, talent, or brand partners.
• Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
• Confident communication skills and the ability to build professional relationships both internally and externally.
• A proactive approach, taking ownership of tasks and identifying solutions before issues arise.
• Strong attention to detail and a process-driven mindset.
• Experience supporting campaigns from planning through to execution and reporting.
• An interest in social media, creator marketing, influencer partnerships, and digital culture.
• Commercial awareness and an understanding of how creator partnerships contribute to brand growth.
• The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities.
• A collaborative mindset combined with the confidence to work independently and take responsibility for outcomes.
 CLOSING DATE: Friday 27th November 2026 
 LOCATION: 
 Please note this is a hybrid role and requires the successful candidate to attend at least 3 days a week in GSIQ, Solihull, UK.
 BELONGING AT GYMSHARK. 
 Our mission is to be a place where everyone belongs. We’re an equal opportunities employer, and for us that means we always strive to be as inclusive as possible in all aspects of employment, right from your application. We’re committed to finding reasonable adjustments* for candidates with specific needs or have a disability during our recruitment process, and all applicants will be considered fairly and equally. We do not tolerate discrimination of any kind. *If you’d like to request a reasonable adjustment please email talent@gymshark.com . 
 ABOUT US. 
 We’re here to unite the conditioning community. We believe that putting the sweat in today, prepares us for tomorrow. So, we give people the tools they need to reach further, go faster, be stronger. We celebrate those who show up – for themselves – to be their physical or mental best, whatever that means for them. It’s what we want for our community, and our team. A team that’s growing rapidly around the world. A collective of talented individuals working together to invent Gymshark’s future. Our plans are ambitious, and we’re looking for people who want to join us for the ride – our growth will be your growth.
 THE PERKS. 
 Standard benefits include:
• Performance-based Bonus opportunity
• Funded Healthcare benefit
• 25 days holiday, additional day for your birthday & Bank Holidays
• Contributory Employer pension scheme
• Flexible benefits programme – including salary sacrifice EV scheme, dental insurance, cycle to work, tech scheme, holiday trading
• Gymshark Employee Discount & long service awards
• Access to High Street cashback and discounts
• Financial, Physical and Mental Wellbeing Support
• Enhanced Family Leave package
• Life Assurance
 Office location specific benefits include (IQ):
• Gym Membership to The Lifting Club (LC)
• Onsite lunch provision & coffee bars
• EV charge points available
 Office location specific benefits include (LDN):
• Funded multi-site fitness membership
 Note: The bonus program and benefits have certain eligibility requirements. Gymshark reserves the right to amend these programs in whole or in part at any time without advance notice.

title: Deployment Lead, Semiconductors - London
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team turns research breakthroughs into production-grade systems. We embed deeply with customers to solve high-leverage problems and act as the delivery engine for our most complex large-scale engagements. We move quickly from prototype to production and surface reusable patterns that shape our platform. We operate at the intersection of deployment and development – working closely with OpenAI Research, Product and Partnerships.



About the Role

As a Deployment Lead, you will define how OpenAI delivers complex systems to Semiconductor customers. You will own how solutions are scoped, built, shipped, and adopted across high-value engineering workflows such as RTL design, verification, and physical implementation. You’ll translate business outcomes into a technical plan, run day-to-day execution across FDEs, Researchers, and Customer Engineers, and partner with customer teams to ensure delivery supports their goals.

You will focus on the semiconductor vertical to deploy next-generation AI capabilities. You will own delivery end-to-end: embedding with customers to map workflows and success criteria, ensuring components ship on time, and leading readiness and change management for adoption. You’ll track progress, manage dependencies, make sequencing decisions, and drive 0→1 prototypes through MVP and scale. You will also share field insights with Product and Research to guide roadmap and priorities.

Success will be measured first and foremost by impact - deployments that deliver measurable value against customer goals, drive adoption, and become critical to their workflows. Additional measures of success include delivery reliability (milestones hit, low reopen/churn), operating leverage (patterns reused across deployments), judgment under pressure, and product impact (field signal that shifts roadmaps/architectures).

This is a high-trust, high-autonomy role. Success requires deep technical project management expertise, extreme ownership of outcomes, and an ability to immerse in customer workflows and partner with customer teams to solve complex engineering problems at pace.



This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel between 25-50% is required.



In this role, you will:

 - Own the technical delivery plan for multiple interdependent work streams, translating customer objectives into a roadmap with milestones, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.

 - Run day-to-day engineering execution by tracking and driving delivery across OpenAI FDE and customer teams. Keep progress unblocked and sequenced. Make real-time trade-offs on scope and priority to protect the critical path.

 - Embed with Semiconductor customer teams to land production deployments and drive adoption. Map workflows, shape tools/integrations, and translate requirements into a delivery plan.

 - Shape production deployments that integrate with customer infrastructure, data systems, and engineering toolchains, including export-controlled environments.

 - Partner with Product and Research so platform components and research work streams land in time to support deployment goals.

 - Codify solution patterns and evals. Extract reusable patterns and package field signals to improve product and models.

 - Own value cases and ROI. Set impact hypotheses, baselines, and KPIs; run pre-/post-deployment measurement and report to exec sponsors.

 - Help define how OpenAI engages Semiconductor customers.



You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Bring 7+ years of customer‑facing technical delivery leadership.

 - Have deep expertise in Semiconductor workflows, including RTL design, verification, EDA tooling, and physical implementation.

 - Track record of successfully leading large, complex, high-stakes customer engagements where customer outcomes depended on tight coordination and fast decision making, ideally involving AI.

 - Excel in high ambiguity environments. Know how to simplify complex and dynamic work.

 - Move fluidly between system level understanding and execution level detail; can dive into customer workflows/data, map constraints, sketch architectures and move ambiguous problems to shipped systems.

 - Think strategically and pattern-match. Able to step back from execution detail, recognize broader trends across deployments, and connect customer needs to scalable, reusable solutions.

 - Have strong technical fluency and sharp sequencing instincts. Confident discussing technical details, pressure-testing architectures, and making trade-offs.

 - Have shipped AI/LLM systems. You understand solution patterns, integration basics, and production pitfalls.

 - You’re a translator with executive presence. You make complex technical trade-offs legible to business leaders and convert strategy into day-to-day technical execution.

 - Enjoy being onsite with customers to accelerate delivery (often 25-50%, sometimes higher).



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. 

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf.

title: Digital and System Lead
description:
Job summary
We are looking for an experienced and motivated People Digital & Systems Lead to join the People & Culture team on a 12-month fixed-term basis. This role has a key part in delivering our new People & Culture operating model. You will lead the digital workstream that enables a single point of entry for the People Service. You will make sure our systems, particularly ServiceNow, support efficient, compliant and user-friendly ways of working for staff and managers across the Trust.
This is an exciting opportunity for someone with strong systems and digital transformation experience to shape how People services are delivered and leave a lasting impact.
Main duties of the job
The People Digital & Systems Lead provides senior digital leadership and hands-on delivery for the People & Culture implementation programme. Reporting to the Head of Implementation & Delivery, you will lead the configuration, optimisation and embedding of ServiceNow and other People systems. You will digitise and streamline People processes, reduce duplication and make sure workflows reflect agreed SOPs and compliance requirements.
You will work closely with the Digital & Information and Data & Analytics teams to make sure systems are joined up and compliant. You will also lead digital adoption across the People & Culture function and make sure everything is handover-ready at the end of the 12 months.
About us
North London NHS Foundation Trust (NLFT) is committed to improving mental health care across North London to deliver excellent services to our local people.
Our Five-Year Strategy: 
We will provide consistently high-quality care closer to home.
With our partners in North London and each borough we will ensure equity of outcome for all
We will offer great places to work, providing staff with supportive environment to deliver outstanding care.
We will be more effective as an organisation by pioneering research, quality improvement and technology.
Why NLFT?
We develop and retain our staff through leadership behaviours and managers programme and many more opportunities.
We promote flexible working and support staff with a range of health and wellbeing initiatives.
NHS Discounts, generous annual leave and NHS pension scheme
Excellent internal staff network
The post holder will be aligned with our values:
We Are Kind
We Are Respectful
We Work Together
We Keep Things Simple
We Empower
We Are Proudly Diverse
In order to meet the needs of the Trust you may be required from time to time to work at different locations to your normal place of work. This may mean that you are required to work at any location that fall under Barnet, Camden, Enfield, Haringey or Islington. The Trust reserves the right to require staff to work at such other places or locations as it considers reasonable and necessary on a temporary or permanent basis.

Digital enablement and systems implementation
Lead the digital enablement workstream within the People & Culture implementation programme.
Review how well the current People systems and digital processes are working, including usage, functionality, value for money and user experience.
Identify gaps, duplication and opportunities to rationalise or improve systems, and make recommendations to the Head of People Implementation & Delivery.

Make sure systems support first-line People Service triage, case management and reporting.
Provide hands-on troubleshooting, ongoing improvements and technical adjustments.
Process and workflow design

Build and refine digital forms, templates, knowledge articles and self-service content.

AI and dashboards
Identify and implement AI opportunities within ServiceNow and People systems, such as virtual agents, chatbots and automated triage, to improve efficiency and the user experience.
Make sure any use of AI is safe, transparent and compliant with information governance, data protection and NHS AI guidance.
Develop dashboards and reporting for each People & Culture service, showing case volumes, query types, response times and outstanding work.
Build a summary dashboard for the People & Culture Senior Leadership Team to support decision-making and performance monitoring.

title: Complaints Team Lead - Cards
description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:



 - One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

 - Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

 - Profitable since 2017

 - Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

 - Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)



So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.



We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.




JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

 1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

 2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

 3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting




ABOUT THE ROLE

As our business grows, we’re looking for a dynamic, adaptable Complaints Team Leader to manage and develop a team of Complaints Officers who handle credit card & personal loan complaints. You’ll lead from the front and build an engaged, high-performing team. That team will resolve complex vehicle complaints fairly, deliver good customer outcomes and drive process improvement, and you’ll champion a data-driven culture throughout.

Your Team’s Objectives
Lendable aims to resolve every complaint promptly, with a diligent and fair investigation for each customer. Feedback is central to how we evolve as a business and keep meeting our customers’ expectations. The team is encouraged to speak up, take each complaint on its own merits and share insights that help the business improve and grow.
Handling complaints well has never mattered more, for our customers and for us, as we grow our products in the UK.

How you’ll impact those objectives

 - Directly manage, support and develop a team of Complaints Officers handling motor finance complaints, making sure they meet individual and team KPIs to high standards in line with FCA regulations.

 - Act as the team’s subject matter expert on credit card complaints including PSD2 complaints.

 - Bring proven experience of fast-paced, evolving financial services environments: embracing ambiguity, managing multiple priorities and guiding your team through significant change.

 The Customer Growth team in Northern Europe is responsible for selling our suite of products into our EMEA install base . The Commercial segment contains Klaviyo’s customers who each drive $2.5-30M in annual revenue, with each rep managing an average book of business of ~700 accounts spread across UK&I, Nordics and Benelux.
 You’ll run the entire sales cycle from prospecting and discovery to demo, negotiation, contracting, and ultimately driving the buying process to close. This is an incredibly exciting time to join the Customer Growth sales team with a growing platform and several newer products to sell.

📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 2 days in the office | 💰 Competitive Salary + Benefits

You’ll make a real difference for our customers and your team from day one. We believe the fastest way to grow is by doing, so we give you the ownership to run with things and see real-time results.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join the Data team, which sits under Tech and Data.

 This role is a 12 month FTC joining a team of experienced analytics engineers and managers to support the increasing Analytical demands across the business. In this role, you will:

 - Design, develop and maintain performant, scalable and best practice Tableau reports.

 - Collaborating with business users to understand their needs with the aim to automate identified manual processes, and create documentation.

We also have award-winning parental leave policies. We're here to support you through the big life moments, from fertility treatments to new additions to the family.




READY TO JOIN A MISSION THAT MATTERS? WE’D LOVE TO CHAT!

title: Staff Data Scientist, Algorithm (Payments Fraud & Optimization)
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

You’ll define and drive the technical strategy for multi-objective payments optimisation, balancing payment conversion, fraud risk and transaction costs. You’ll own complex, cross-functional initiatives that improve payments performance and influence product adoption at scale.

 - Define algorithmic approaches such as contextual bandits, alongside experimentation methods including A/B testing and causal inference.

 - Partner with Engineering to build the tools, infrastructure and production machine-learning systems that enable optimisation at scale.

 - Work with Product, Engineering, Risk and Commercial teams to influence product strategy and investment decisions.

 - Communicate complex data insights and technical recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring your work drives decisions.

 - Mentor and coach data scientists and engineers, raising the bar for technical practice across the team.

You’ll work from our London office three days a week.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essentials

 - An advanced degree, such as a PhD or master’s, in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics or a related discipline.

 - 5+ years of industry experience in data science or applied machine learning.

 - Strong experience with experimentation and causal inference to drive data-informed product decisions with measurable impact.

 - Experience operating as a technical leader, defining critical systems and influencing product strategy in a high-growth environment.

 - Proficiency in SQL and Python or R.

 - Experience using LLMs, AI and agents to improve processes or machine-learning models.

Preferred

 - Experience deploying machine-learning systems to production.

 - Experience with payments optimisation, fraud detection, risk modelling or other complex decisioning systems.

 - Experience with contextual bandits or other online optimisation methods.


YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

 - You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

 - You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

 - You’re comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA.

 - You come to the table with a point of view, not just a problem.


LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

Risk Platform builds the decisioning infrastructure that sits between Airwallex and every dollar that moves through it, protecting 150,000+ businesses moving over US$260 billion a year across 150+ countries and 60+ currencies, and deciding, often in milliseconds, whether a new signup is real, a payment is safe, or a login is who they claim to be. The hard part is that fraud evolves fast, and every decision carries a two-sided cost: miss an attack and money is lost, over-block and a legitimate business can't get paid. We build this with streaming pipelines processing billions of events a day, graph databases exposing coordinated fraud rings, ML models scoring every transaction, and LLM agents that triage alerts. You don't need a fintech background, just an appetite for adversarial systems problems where the scoreboard is measured in dollars. If you want to help scale one of the world's fastest-growing financial platforms safely, this is the team.


APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Maternity Transformation and Oversight Lead
description:
Job summary
As a Maternity transformation and oversight Lead, the post holder will work as part of a dynamic team in delivering an effective service supporting managers and staff across the London's Perinatal Team to support integrated care systems and providers with the delivery of improvement in health outcomes for women, babies and families.
The role combines system transformation, service improvement, quality assurance, governance, patient safety and professional leadership. Working across organisational boundaries, the post holder will support delivery of national policy, drive improvements in outcomes and experience, influence strategic decision-making and provide expert advice to senior leaders across complex healthcare systems.
The post holder will play a key role in supporting implementation of national priorities arising from the NHS 10 Year Health Plan for England, the NHS 10 Point Plan for Maternity and Neonatal Services, the emerging National Maternity and Neonatal Service Framework, and recommendations from national maternity investigations and reviews, including the Nottingham Review and Baroness Amos' investigation.
Main duties of the job
Support the Regional Chief Midwife in delivering regional strategic priorities for maternity and neonatal services.
Lead and support transformational programmes aligned to the NHS 10 Year Health Plan for England and emerging National Maternity and Neonatal Service Framework.
Provide professional expert advice on maternity safety, quality improvement, governance and service transformation.
Drive improvement programmes focused on reducing unwarranted variation and improving outcomes and experiences for women, babies and families.
Support systems and providers to address inequalities in maternity and neonatal care through evidence-based and data-driven approaches.
Develop productive partnerships with Integrated Care Boards, provider organisations, Local Maternity and Neonatal Systems and national stakeholders.
Support challenged organisations through improvement activity, focused oversight and peer support.
Promote compassionate, respectful and personalised care through system leadership and quality improvement programmes.
Promote digital innovation, population health approaches and data-informed decision making.
About us
NHS England has a wide range of statutory functions, responsibilities and regulatory powers. These are focused on supporting the wider NHS to deliver high quality care, as well as doing those things that are best done once for the whole NHS.
Our staff bring expertise across clinical, operational, commissioning, technology, data science, cyber security, software engineering, education, and commercial specialisms -- enabling us to design and deliver high-quality NHS services.
In March 2025, the Government announced that NHS England and the Department of Health and Social Care will increasingly merge functions, ultimately leading to NHS England being fully integrated into the department.
If you currently work within the NHS and if successful at interview, we will initiate an Inter Authority Transfer (IAT) via the Electronic Staff Record (ESR).This retrieves key data from your current or previous NHS employer to support onboarding, including competency status, Continuous Service Dates (CSD), and annual leave entitlement. You may opt out at any stage of the process.
Colleagues with a contractual office base are expected to spend, on average, at least 40% of their time working in our offices.

description:
Job summary
The post holder will be a key member of the Project Team and will have an important role in ensuring delivery of a high quality capital project. Be professionally accountable for estates project construction and implementation of delegated Schemes within the Trust's Investment Programme to improve the environment for patients and staff.
The post holder is the lead specialist responsible for long term planning, preparing and managing the Estates capital project under the Our Capital Project Programme at various stages from writing, briefing to completion of the Business Case process. To ensure that they are completed in an efficient and effective manner, within programme timeframes and to provide the highest possible standards of Business Case delivery within the resources allocated, ensuring statutory compliance.
The post holder is responsible for the management of capital projects from inception to completion ensuring the delivery of projects on time, within budget, to the required quality and which improve the patient's environment, including the project planning to deliver Business Case requirements and deliverables within overall programme timeframes. Compliance to programme governance and processes to ensure delivery within these parameters.
Main duties of the job
    To work as a specialist professional as part of the Estates Department.
    To provide expert specialist and professional construction and estates projects advice to other Estates staff, Directors, Senior Management, Trust Boards and external agencies.
    To independently manage a portfolio of complicated delegated projects from inception to completion, including full project management, design, costs, contract administration, site supervision and commissioning under the Trust Capital Programme.
    To appoint and manage external professional consultants within an authorised budget as a Budget Holder.
    To manage Estates Capital Budgets, professional services, contractor works and physical assets as part of the Trust Capital Programme.
    To be responsible for producing and implementing a number of department processes and procedures.
    To support and deputise for Senior Managers within the Estates Department as and when required.
    Responsible for the operational commissioning of health buildings
    To provide guidance and leadership to Trainee Project Managers.
    To provide cover for colleagues as appropriate and delegate for the Capital Manager as and when required and during periods of absence.
    Line management of the 8a Capital Projects Manager and Project Assistants.
About us
The Hillingdon Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust is the only acute Hospital in the London Borough of Hillingdon and offers a wide range of services including accident and emergency, inpatient care, day surgery, outpatient clinics and maternity services. The Trust's services at Mount Vernon Hospital include routine day surgery, delivered at a modern treatment centre, a minor injuries unit and outpatient clinics.

 Are you passionate about fitness, creator culture, and building meaningful partnerships? We're looking for a highly organised Partnerships Executive to support the growth and activation of our athlete and influencer network while driving operational excellence behind the scenes.

You'll sit at the heart of our Athlete Marketing function, overseeing the processes, timelines, and cross-functional collaboration required to successfully onboard talent, deliver campaigns, execute product launches, and scale partnership activity across international markets.
 Working closely with talent, agencies, finance, operations, and wider marketing teams, you'll combine relationship management with strong project coordination skills to keep campaigns running smoothly from planning through to reporting.
 WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING: 
• Manage the end-to-end onboarding process for athletes, influencers, and partners, ensuring a seamless experience from contract through to activation.
• Coordinate multiple partnership projects simultaneously, keeping stakeholders aligned, deadlines met, and deliverables on track.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with talent, agents, and management teams.
• Own key operational workflows including contracts, invoicing, affiliate set-up, vendor creation, and talent administration.
• Develop and maintain project trackers, databases, and reporting tools that enable the team to scale efficiently.

• Monitor content delivery and campaign execution, ensuring all activity meets brand, compliance, and contractual requirements.

• Measure and report on partnership performance against agreed KPIs, providing regular insights and recommendations.

description:
Job summary
This is an exciting opportunity to develop your management skills in a 6-month, fixed term Operations Manager role. The role provides management oversight across the two Blood Sciences ESLs in Guys and St Thomas and the 3 near patient testing clinics. This role will be accountable for managing a team of scientific employees and support workers and will be responsible for delivering a discipline specific service as part of the laboratory team in Synnovis.
Reporting to the Deputy Operations Director, you will have a high level of responsibility including leading in an area of expertise to ensure the successful operational delivery of pathology services, in line with our corporate objectives.
Main duties of the job
You will hold a variety of accountabilities in the laboratory environment. These include, but are not limited to: 
Direct and indirect line management responsibility for all employees in your service including delivering all aspects of people management, such as recruitment, performance management, absence management, learning and development, employee health and wellbeing.
Manage employee availability and shift allocation to ensure required employee resource levels, including where necessary, and within budget, temporary staffing requisitions, time sheet approval and overtime.
Ensure that all areas of responsibility comply with legislation and conform with ISO 15189 and the recommendations from recognised professional bodies.
Ensure the delivery and continuity of a diagnostic pathology service that enables high standards of patient care, maintaining all regulatory accreditation whilst delivering service improvement initiatives.
The laboratories within the department are dynamic and fast paced and will require a high level of management to ensure the 24/7 service is always delivered to a high level to meet the requirements of the hospitals sites.
About us
Your development and learning 
You will have a suite of learning opportunities available through The ACCE competencies programme, the Scientific Learning and Development Fund and the Synnovis Academy through which you can receive funding / support for advanced qualifications.

title: Technical Delivery Lead, EMEA
description:
ABOUT US

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

 - We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

 - We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

 - We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The Role


As Technical Delivery Lead, EMEA, you will own how Legora's customers across the region go live and scale. You will lead and grow a team of Technical Delivery Managers who run end-to-end implementations, from SSO to document-management integrations, and you will stay close enough to the work to step into the projects yourself.


This is a player-coach role. You set the delivery standard for EMEA, make sure every customer has a clear path from kickoff to adoption, and act as the link between the delivery team and Sales, Customer Success, Engineering and Product. You will also help shape the delivery playbook as Legora keeps expanding across the region.


What You'll Do


Lead the EMEA delivery team

 - Manage, coach and develop a team of Technical Delivery Managers across EMEA, including hiring, onboarding and performance

 - Allocate projects across the team based on complexity, customer priority and capacity, and keep workloads sustainable

 - Set clear expectations for quality, timelines and customer communication, and hold the team to them
   

Own delivery outcomes for the region

 - Oversee the pipeline of integration projects from kickoff through go-live, and step in early when a project is at risk

 - Act as the senior technical escalation point for complex implementations, including SSO, authentication, and document-management integrations

 - Track delivery metrics such as time to go-live, project health and customer satisfaction, and report on them to leadership

 - Stay hands-on with select strategic customer projects
   

Build the delivery engine

 - Standardise how EMEA delivers: playbooks, technical documentation, test plans and rollout checklists that the team can reuse

 - Improve how delivery hands off to support, Customer Success and adoption teams after go-live

 - Work with global delivery leads so that practices stay consistent across regions while reflecting local customer needs, such as data residency and regional security requirements
   

Work across the business

 - Partner with GtM and Solutions Engineering on scoping and technical feasibility before deals close, so commitments made to customers can be delivered

 - Work with Engagement and Legal Engineering to turn successful go-lives into lasting adoption

 - Bring patterns from delivery projects back to Engineering and Product to influence the roadmap and make future implementations easier


Who You Are


 - Proven experience in technical delivery, implementation, or a similar customer-facing technical role, including at least 2 years leading or managing a team

 - Strong hands-on background with enterprise integrations and implementation

 - A track record of running multiple parallel implementation projects with a structured, proactive approach to blockers and risk

 - Experience building repeatable delivery processes, not only running individual projects

 - Able to translate technical concepts clearly for non-technical audiences, including senior customer stakeholders

 - A strong communicator who builds trusted relationships across customer and internal teams

 - A coach who gives direct, useful feedback and helps people grow

 - Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

 - Based in, or willing to relocate to, one of our EMEA hubs, with the flexibility to work with customers across European time zones
   

Nice to Have


 - Experience delivering software to law firms, in-house legal teams or other regulated, security-conscious customers

 - Familiarity with SSO, iManage, SharePoint or similar document management platforms

 - Experience with EMEA data residency, GDPR and enterprise security review requirements

 - Fluency in one or more European languages in addition to English

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: National Account Manager, QSR
description:
Our Global Structure 
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
 Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.
 We’re looking for a National Account Manager, QSR to join our UKI team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll manage the daily relationship with a portfolio of our major Quick Service Restaurant (QSR) partners, using data-driven insights to grow their sales and help them achieve operational excellence.
 Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.
 What You’ll Be Doing 
 You’ll be joining the National Accounts team. Working with major Quick Service Restaurant partners at national scale means you will often tackle high-volume challenges that Deliveroo is solving for the first time, directly shaping the future of how we collaborate with leading fast-food brands.
 Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:
• Strategic Relationship Management: Act as the primary consultant for a portfolio of key QSR partners, leading weekly operational meetings and high-level performance reviews.
• Data-Driven Insight: Monitor and analyse partner-specific metrics, creating compelling narratives from complex datasets to show partners where and how they can improve.
• Consultative Growth: Increase revenue and operational health metrics by advising QSR partners on best practices for selection, pricing, and rapid service levels.
• Operational Training & Execution: Deliver in-person training sessions for key partners covering operational best practices, Deliveroo insights, and on-site troubleshooting.
• Marketing & Regional Collaboration: Partner with restaurant marketing counterparts and regional Commercial Managers to design high-impact campaigns and unlock growth opportunities across specific UK zones.
• Cross-Functional Advocacy: Identify opportunities to deepen relationships by involving and working closely with Deliveroo’s Marketing, Operations, and Product teams.
 What You’ll Need to Thrive 
 Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
• Partnership Expertise: Proven experience in account management or a commercial partnerships role, ideally within a high-growth technology, QSR, or marketplace environment.
• Analytical Rigour: Demonstrated ability to manage large datasets and translate them into clear, applicable insights that drive commercial decisions.
• Creative Problem-Solving: The ability to think outside the box to overcome complex commercial and operational hurdles, designing bespoke solutions when standard playbooks don't apply.
• Communication & Influence: Effective relationship-building skills with the ability to communicate and present confidently to key stakeholders.
• Operational Agility: A proactive approach to problem-solving and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced setting.
• Collaborative Mindset: A team player who can work across functions to deliver complex, multi-layered projects.
 What’s in it for you 
 At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:
 🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.
 🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.
 🧠 Build a career, not just a role Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.
 🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.
 We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.
 Diversity, Equity and Inclusion 
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
 We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.
 If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
 If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!
 Privacy 
 Deliveroo will process your personal information in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy .
